            AND NOT EXISTS(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(wi.result#>'{decision,npc_intents}') ni
              where ni->>'entry_kind'='offense')
            AND EXISTS(select 1 from mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit failure_audit
              where failure_audit.receipt_id=receipt.id
                and failure_audit.event_code='generic_finalized'
                and failure_audit.details->>'work_id'=wi.id::text
                and failure_audit.details->>'state'='failed'
                and failure_audit.details->>'application_error_sqlstate'='22023'
                and failure_audit.details->>'outcome_uncertain'='false')))
        AND wi.payload_sha256=source_row.source_sha256
        AND receipt.authority_receipt_id=wi.id
        AND receipt.master_session_id=wi.master_session_id
        AND receipt.status IN ('success','fallback')
        AND receipt.dispatch_count=1 AND receipt.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
        AND receipt.charged_cost_usd IS NOT NULL
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit audit
          WHERE audit.receipt_id=receipt.id
            AND audit.event_code='staff_failed_director_validation_retry'
            AND audit.details->>'master_session_id'=source_row.master_session_id::text
            AND audit.details->>'work_id'=wi.id::text
            AND audit.details->>'source_window_id'=source_row.id::text)
    );
  END IF;
  IF source_row.superseded_reason='new_role_before_provider' THEN
    RETURN NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items wi
      LEFT JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts receipt
        ON receipt.id=wi.dispatch_receipt_id
      WHERE (wi.id=source_row.work_id OR wi.id IN (
        SELECT batch.writer_work_id FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches batch
        WHERE batch.source_window_id=p_source AND batch.writer_work_id IS NOT NULL))
        AND wi.state='failed'
        AND (wi.finalized_at IS NULL OR
          (receipt.id IS NOT NULL AND
            (receipt.status<>'failed' OR receipt.dispatch_count<>0
              OR receipt.charged_cost_usd IS DISTINCT FROM 0)))
    );
  END IF;
  SELECT coalesce((SELECT batch.writer_work_id
      FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches batch
      WHERE batch.source_window_id=p_source AND batch.writer_work_id IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY batch.created_at DESC,batch.id DESC LIMIT 1),source_row.work_id)
    INTO stale_work;
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items wi
    JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts receipt
      ON receipt.id=wi.dispatch_receipt_id
    WHERE wi.id=stale_work AND wi.master_session_id=source_row.master_session_id
      AND wi.state='failed' AND wi.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
      AND receipt.authority_receipt_id=wi.id
      AND receipt.master_session_id=source_row.master_session_id
      AND receipt.status IN ('success','fallback')
      AND receipt.dispatch_count=1 AND receipt.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
      AND receipt.charged_cost_usd IS NOT NULL
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit audit
        WHERE audit.receipt_id=receipt.id AND audit.event_code='generic_finalized'
          AND audit.details->>'work_id'=wi.id::text
          AND audit.details->>'stale'='true'
          AND audit.details->>'state'='failed'
          AND audit.details->>'outcome_uncertain'='false'
          AND audit.details->>'cost_basis'='exact')
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.unified_enqueue_director(p_session uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare mr public.mission_run_state;rb mission_generic_owner.run_bindings;ctx jsonb;sc jsonb;opps jsonb:='[]';
 item jsonb;destctx jsonb;destscene jsonb;destspec jsonb;deststep text;wid uuid:=gen_random_uuid();cutoff timestamptz:=clock_timestamp();opening_at timestamptz;last_context_at timestamptz;ids uuid[];fresh_ids uuid[];sw uuid;payload jsonb;final_trigger text;last_writer mission_generic_owner.work_items;final_fato public.messages;final_route jsonb;
begin

 -- Explicit incomplete recovery keeps the normal builder and exact accepted role cohort.
 DECLARE prep50 jsonb;old50 mission_generic_owner.work_items;sw50 mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows;
 BEGIN
  SELECT a.details INTO prep50 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a
   JOIN mission_generic_owner.work_items oldw ON oldw.dispatch_receipt_id=a.receipt_id
   WHERE oldw.master_session_id=p_session AND a.event_code='staff_director_incomplete_prepared_v1'
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit done WHERE done.receipt_id=a.receipt_id AND done.event_code='staff_director_incomplete_reissued_v1');
  IF FOUND THEN
   SELECT * INTO STRICT old50 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=(prep50->>'old_work_id')::uuid;
   SELECT * INTO STRICT sw50 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows WHERE id=old50.authority_receipt_id AND work_id=old50.id;
   IF mission_generic_owner.director_incomplete_reissue_proof_v1(old50.id,NULL)->'source_released' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'DIRECTOR50_BUILDER_PROOF' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
   wid:=(prep50->>'successor_work_id')::uuid;
  END IF;
 END;

 if not mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(p_session) then return mission_generic_owner.flow_previous_unified_enqueue_director(p_session);end if; 
perform mission_ai_board_owner.service_only();
if exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
  where c.master_session_id=p_session) then
  perform 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
    where c.master_session_id=p_session for update;
  if exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_reissues ri
    where ri.master_session_id=p_session and ri.state='armed') then
    raise exception 'MRS_V4_LEGACY_REISSUE_ACTIVE' using errcode='40001';
  end if;
end if;
perform mission_generic_owner.assert_runtime(p_session);

 perform public.master_v2_lock_scope(p_session);
 select * into strict mr from public.mission_run_state where master_session_id=p_session;
 select * into strict rb from mission_generic_owner.run_bindings where master_session_id=p_session;
 if exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows uw where uw.master_session_id=p_session and uw.consumed_message_id is null and uw.superseded_at is null)
 then return jsonb_build_object('state','window_pending');end if;
 -- Academy valuation is complete only after the Fato for the preceding transition is published.
 -- The terminal route is a server receipt, not an invented PG role or a player click.
 if mission_academy_owner.is_academy(mr.mission_id) and mr.current_step_key='valutazione' then
  if exists(select 1 from public.combat_v2_sessions cs where cs.master_session_id=p_session and
   (cs.state<>'chiuso' or cs.closed_at is null))
   or exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.work_items wi
    where wi.master_session_id=p_session and wi.state<>'completed'
      and not (exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
        where c.master_session_id=p_session)
        and wi.state='failed'
        and (wi.result->>'reason'='new_role_before_provider'
          or exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows stale_window
            left join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches stale_batch
              on stale_batch.source_window_id=stale_window.id
            where stale_window.master_session_id=p_session
              and mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(stale_window.id)
              and (stale_window.work_id=wi.id or stale_batch.writer_work_id=wi.id)))))
  then return jsonb_build_object('state','waiting_publication');end if;
  select wi.* into last_writer from mission_generic_owner.work_items wi
   join public.messages msg on msg.id=wi.message_id and msg.kind='fato' and msg.recipient_user is null
   left join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub on ub.writer_work_id=wi.id and ub.state='published'
   where wi.master_session_id=p_session and wi.kind='narration' and wi.state='completed'
    and (wi.step_key='valutazione' and wi.run_control_version=mr.control_version
     or ub.composition_kind='combat_exit' and ub.route->>'to_step_key'='valutazione')
   order by wi.finalized_at desc,wi.id desc limit 1;
  if last_writer.id is null then return jsonb_build_object('state','waiting_publication');end if;
  select * into strict final_fato from public.messages where id=last_writer.message_id and kind='fato' and recipient_user is null;
  select t.value->>'trigger_key' into strict final_trigger
   from jsonb_array_elements(mission_generic_owner.scene(p_session,'valutazione')->'triggers') as t(value)
   join public.mission_plan_transitions pt on pt.plan_version_id=mr.plan_version_id
    and pt.from_step_key='valutazione' and pt.transition_key=t.value->>'transition_key'
   where t.value->>'source_kind'='narrative_event' and pt.to_step_key='rapid_success';
  final_route:=mission_generic_owner.apply_authority(p_session,
   mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(p_session,'academy-final:'||mr.control_version),
   (select control_version from public.master_v2_sessions where id=p_session),mr.control_version,
   final_trigger,'narrative_event',last_writer.message_id,
   encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(final_fato.body,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),null);
  perform mission_generic_owner.enqueue_transition(p_session,(final_route->>'authority_receipt_id')::uuid);
  return jsonb_build_object('state','terminal_narration_ready','transition',final_route);
 end if;
 ctx:=mission_generic_owner.narrative_context(p_session,mr.current_step_key,wid,cutoff,'{}');
 if ctx->>'schema_version'<>'mission-narrative-context/2' then raise exception 'MUF_CREATION_CONTEXT_REQUIRED';end if;
 if exists(select 1 from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources where session_id=p_session) then
   select msg.created_at into strict opening_at from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources q
     join public.mission_run_messages rm on rm.publication_id=q.opening_publication_id
     join public.messages msg on msg.id=rm.message_id and msg.kind='fato' and msg.recipient_user is null
     where q.session_id=p_session and q.state='started';
 else
 select msg.created_at into strict opening_at from mission_generic_owner.board_starts bs
 join mission_generic_owner.work_items ow on ow.master_session_id=bs.master_session_id
 and ow.payload->>'opening_start_receipt_id'=bs.id::text and ow.kind='narration' and ow.state='completed'
 join public.messages msg on msg.id=ow.message_id and msg.kind='fato' and msg.recipient_user is null
 where bs.master_session_id=p_session and bs.state='published';
 end if;
 -- The opening is mandatory. Roles before its real publication cannot answer it.
 ctx:=jsonb_set(ctx,'{sources}',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(sr order by ord),'[]')
 from jsonb_array_elements(ctx->'sources') with ordinality z(sr,ord)
 where sr->>'kind'<>'role' or exists(select 1 from public.messages rm where rm.id::text=sr->>'id'
 and rm.created_at>opening_at and nullif(btrim(rm.body),'') is not null)));

 -- Solo reissue esplicito della precedente finestra Suna già pubblicata.
 -- Il contesto attuale conserva nuovo piano, Creation e autorità; si recuperano
 -- soltanto le fonti pubbliche originarie (role e Fato antecedente), non
 -- la prosa ormai superata dell'ultimo Fato.
 if not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
     where c.master_session_id=p_session)
   and p_session='b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
   and mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(p_session)
   and exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_reissues ri
     where ri.master_session_id=p_session and ri.state='armed') then
   if (select count(*) from mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_reissues ri
      join mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows old
        on old.id=ri.old_window_id and old.master_session_id=ri.master_session_id
      where ri.master_session_id=p_session and ri.state='armed'
        and old.consumed_message_id=ri.old_fato_id
        and old.superseded_at is not null
        and old.role_ids=ri.role_ids
        and jsonb_typeof(old.context->'sources')='array'
        and (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(old.context->'sources') src
          where src->>'kind'='role')=3
        and (select array_agg((src->>'id')::uuid order by (src->>'sequence')::bigint)
          from jsonb_array_elements(old.context->'sources') src
          where src->>'kind'='role')=ri.role_ids
        and not exists(select 1 from unnest(ri.role_ids) role(role_id)
          where not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(old.context->'sources') src
            join public.messages msg on msg.id=role.role_id
            where src->>'id'=role.role_id::text and src->>'kind'='role'
              and src->>'body'=msg.body
              and src->>'sha256'=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(msg.body,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
              and msg.kind='say' and msg.recipient_user is null)))<>1
   then raise exception 'SUNAV3_REISSUE_SOURCE_DRIFT' using errcode='40001';end if;
   ctx:=jsonb_set(ctx,'{sources}',(select old.context->'sources'
      from mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_reissues ri
      join mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows old on old.id=ri.old_window_id
      where ri.master_session_id=p_session and ri.state='armed'),true);
 end if;
 select array_agg((v->>'id')::uuid order by (v->>'sequence')::bigint) into ids from jsonb_array_elements(ctx->'sources') v where v->>'kind'='role';
 select max(fato.created_at) into last_context_at from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows uw
  join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub on ub.source_window_id=uw.id
  join public.messages fato on fato.id=ub.message_id and fato.kind='fato' and fato.recipient_user is null
  where uw.master_session_id=p_session and uw.step_key=mr.current_step_key
   and uw.run_control_version=mr.control_version and ub.composition_kind='narrative_continuation'
   and ub.state='published';
 -- Older roles remain narrative context; every participant answers the latest published Fato.
 if exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
    where c.master_session_id=p_session) then
   select array_agg(lr.message_id order by lr.submission_order) into fresh_ids
     from mission_generic_owner.role_latest_v1(p_session) lr
     where lr.valid and lr.message_id=any(ids);
  else
   select array_agg(rm.id order by rm.created_at,rm.id) into fresh_ids
     from public.messages rm where rm.id=any(ids)
       and rm.created_at>coalesce(last_context_at,opening_at);
  end if;
 -- Eccezione monouso: solo le tre role della finestra Suna Staff con reissue
 -- esplicito, gia' validate sopra e col Fato precedente marcato superato.
 if not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
     where c.master_session_id=p_session)
   and p_session='b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
   and exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_reissues ri
     join mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows old
       on old.id=ri.old_window_id and old.master_session_id=ri.master_session_id
     where ri.master_session_id=p_session and ri.state='armed'
       and ri.role_ids=ids and cardinality(ids)=3
       and old.consumed_message_id=ri.old_fato_id
       and old.superseded_at is not null)
 then fresh_ids:=ids;end if;
 if not (case when exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
    where c.master_session_id=p_session)
  then mission_generic_owner.role_window_ready_v1(p_session,fresh_ids,cutoff)
  else mission_generic_owner.unified_roles_ready(p_session,fresh_ids,cutoff) end)
 then return jsonb_build_object('state','waiting_roles');end if;
 sc:=mission_generic_owner.scene(p_session,mr.current_step_key);
 for item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'encounters') loop
  if not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.encounters ee where ee.master_session_id=p_session
    and ee.run_control_version=mr.control_version and ee.encounter_key=item->>'encounter_key')
   and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(item->'actors') encounter_actor
    where not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
      where ar.mission_id=mr.mission_id and ar.actor_key=encounter_actor->>'actor_key' and ar.active
        and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants p
          where p.session_id=p_session and p.left_at is null and p.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster)
      and not mission_generic_owner.npc_entry_actor_visible(p_session,mr.current_step_key,
        encounter_actor->>'actor_key',null)) then
   opps:=opps||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('opportunity_id',mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(wid,'encounter:'||(item->>'encounter_key')),
    'trigger_key',null,'source_kind',null,'label','Scontro possibile nella scena','action_kind','conflict','destination_context',case when exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'actors') entry_actor where entry_actor ? 'entry_policy' and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(item->'actors') encounter_actor where encounter_actor->>'actor_key'=entry_actor->>'actor_key')) then jsonb_set(ctx,'{sources}',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(source_item),'[]'::jsonb) from jsonb_array_elements(ctx->'sources') source_item where source_item->>'kind'='setting')) else null end,'encounter_key',item->>'encounter_key','allowed_entry_sides',jsonb_build_array('pg','png'),
    'destination_entry_candidates',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('actor_key',entry_actor->>'actor_key',
      'visible_on_enter',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,visible_on_enter}',
      'visibility_trigger_key',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,visibility_trigger_key}',
      'entry_capabilities',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,entry_capabilities}',
      'offense_allowed',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,offense_allowed}') order by ord),'[]'::jsonb)
     from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'actors') with ordinality current_actors(entry_actor,ord)
     where entry_actor ? 'entry_policy' and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(item->'actors') encounter_actor
       where encounter_actor->>'actor_key'=entry_actor->>'actor_key')
       and not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
       where ar.mission_id=mr.mission_id and ar.actor_key=entry_actor->>'actor_key' and ar.active
         and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants p where p.session_id=p_session and p.left_at is null and p.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster)),
    'allowed_actor_keys',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(aa->>'actor_key'),'[]') from jsonb_array_elements(item->'actors') aa
    where not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
     where ar.mission_id=mr.mission_id and ar.actor_key=aa->>'actor_key' and ar.active
      and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants p
       where p.session_id=p_session and p.left_at is null and p.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster))));
  end if;
 end loop;
 for item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'triggers') where value->>'source_kind' in('narrative_event','player_choice')
  and not (mission_academy_owner.is_academy(mr.mission_id) and value->>'fact_code' in('academy_d100_success','academy_d100_complication')) loop
  select pt.to_step_key into strict deststep from public.mission_plan_transitions pt where pt.plan_version_id=mr.plan_version_id
   and pt.from_step_key=mr.current_step_key and pt.transition_key=item->>'transition_key';
  destscene:=mission_generic_owner.scene(p_session,deststep);destspec:=null;destctx:=null;
  if EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_admissions_v1 ma WHERE ma.master_session_id=p_session) OR exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c where c.master_session_id=p_session)
    or jsonb_array_length(destscene->'encounters')=1
    or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(destscene->'actors') entry_actor where entry_actor ? 'entry_policy') then
   destspec:=case when destscene ? 'arrival_conflict'
     or mission_generic_owner.mandatory_arrival(mr.plan_version_id,destscene)
     or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(destscene->'actors') entry_actor
       where entry_actor#>>'{entry_policy,offense_allowed}'='true' and entry_actor#>>'{entry_policy,visible_on_enter}'='true')
    then destscene->'encounters'->0 else null end;
   -- La topologia obbligatoria del piano approvato mantiene l'ingaggio; il marker ne precisa causa e lato.
   if destspec is not null and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(destspec->'actors') encounter_actor
      left join lateral (select a->'entry_policy' policy from jsonb_array_elements(destscene->'actors') a
        where a->>'actor_key'=encounter_actor->>'actor_key') actor_policy on true
      where actor_policy.policy is not null
        and not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
          where ar.mission_id=mr.mission_id and ar.actor_key=encounter_actor->>'actor_key' and ar.active
            and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants p
              where p.session_id=p_session and p.left_at is null and p.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster)
        and actor_policy.policy->>'visible_on_enter'='false'
        and actor_policy.policy->>'visibility_trigger_key' is distinct from item->>'trigger_key')
   then destspec:=null;end if;
   destctx:=mission_generic_owner.narrative_context(p_session,deststep,wid,cutoff,
     jsonb_build_object('entry_preview','private'));
   destctx:=jsonb_set(destctx,'{sources}',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(ds),'[]') from jsonb_array_elements(destctx->'sources') ds where ds->>'kind'='setting'));
  end if;
  opps:=opps||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('opportunity_id',mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(wid,'trigger:'||(item->>'trigger_key')),
   'trigger_key',item->>'trigger_key','source_kind',item->>'source_kind','label',left(item->>'label'||case when destspec is null then ''
    else ' Causa visibile: '||coalesce(destscene#>>'{arrival_conflict,public_cause}',
      nullif(btrim(destctx#>>'{director_context,entry_public}'),''),item->>'label') end,300),
   'action_kind',case when item->>'source_kind'='player_choice' then item->>'trigger_key' else coalesce(item->>'fact_code','phase_transition') end,'destination_context',destctx,'encounter_key',destspec->>'encounter_key',
   'allowed_entry_sides',case when destspec is null then '[]'::jsonb
    when destscene ? 'arrival_conflict' then jsonb_build_array(destscene#>>'{arrival_conflict,entry_side}')
    else jsonb_build_array('pg','png') end,
   'destination_entry_candidates',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('actor_key',entry_actor->>'actor_key',
     'visible_on_enter',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,visible_on_enter}',
     'visibility_trigger_key',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,visibility_trigger_key}',
     'entry_capabilities',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,entry_capabilities}',
     'offense_allowed',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,offense_allowed}') order by ord),'[]'::jsonb)
     from jsonb_array_elements(destscene->'actors') with ordinality actors(entry_actor,ord)
     where entry_actor ? 'entry_policy' and not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
       where ar.mission_id=mr.mission_id and ar.actor_key=entry_actor->>'actor_key' and ar.active
         and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants p where p.session_id=p_session and p.left_at is null and p.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster)),
   'allowed_actor_keys',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(aa->>'actor_key'),'[]') from jsonb_array_elements(case when destctx is null then '[]'::jsonb else destscene->'actors' end) aa
    where not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
     where ar.mission_id=mr.mission_id and ar.actor_key=aa->>'actor_key' and ar.active
      and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants p
       where p.session_id=p_session and p.left_at is null and p.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster))));
 end loop;
 if exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(opps) candidate_op
   where jsonb_array_length(coalesce(candidate_op->'destination_entry_candidates','[]'::jsonb))>0) then
   select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_set(candidate_op,'{allowed_actor_keys}',
     coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(legacy_key))
       from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(candidate_op->'allowed_actor_keys','[]'::jsonb)) as legacy_keys(legacy_key)
       where not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(candidate_op->'destination_entry_candidates','[]'::jsonb)) policy_actor
         where policy_actor->>'actor_key'=legacy_key)),'[]'::jsonb)) order by ord),'[]'::jsonb)
     into opps from jsonb_array_elements(opps) with ordinality opportunities(candidate_op,ord);
   payload:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-director-work/2','source_window_id',wid,'context',ctx,'opportunities',opps);
 else
   if not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
     where c.master_session_id=p_session) then
     select coalesce(jsonb_agg(candidate_op-'destination_entry_candidates' order by ord),'[]'::jsonb) into opps
       from jsonb_array_elements(opps) with ordinality opportunities(candidate_op,ord);
   end if;
   
payload:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version',
  case when exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
    where c.master_session_id=p_session) then 'mission-director-work/2'
    else 'mission-director-work/1' end,
  'source_window_id',wid,'context',ctx,'opportunities',opps);

 end if;
 sw:=wid;
 if exists(select 1 from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources where session_id=p_session) then
   select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
     'opportunity_id',mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(wid,'quest-terminal:'||(opt->>'decision_key')),
     'quest_terminal_decision_key',opt->>'decision_key','trigger_key',null,'source_kind','narrative_event',
     'label',opt->>'decision_key','action_kind','quest_terminal','destination_context',null,
     'encounter_key',null,'allowed_entry_sides','[]'::jsonb,'allowed_actor_keys','[]'::jsonb) order by opt->>'decision_key'),'[]'::jsonb)||opps
   into opps from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'terminal_options') opt
   join mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources q on q.session_id=p_session
   join mission_generic_owner.definitions df on df.id=q.definition_id
   join mission_factory_owner.quest_decision_registry reg on reg.catalog_version=df.definition->>'catalog_version'
     and reg.catalog_sha256=df.definition->>'catalog_sha256' and reg.capability_key='terminal.result'
     and reg.decision_key=opt->>'decision_key' and reg.qualified and reg.terminal_route
     and reg.step_kind='narrative' and reg.trigger_source_kind='narrative_event';
   payload:=jsonb_set(payload,'{opportunities}',opps);
   payload:=mission_factory_owner.quest_step_payload_v1(p_session,sw,payload);
 end if;
 IF mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_scope_v2(p_session,true) THEN
  ctx:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_progression_context_v2(p_session,ctx);
  payload:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_prepare_v2(p_session,sw,ctx,opps);
  ctx:=payload->'context';opps:=payload->'opportunities';
 ELSIF mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_scope_v1(p_session,true) THEN
  ctx:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_progression_context_v1(p_session,ctx);
  payload:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_prepare_v1(p_session,sw,ctx,opps);
  ctx:=payload->'context';opps:=payload->'opportunities';
 END IF;
 insert into mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows(id,master_session_id,step_key,run_control_version,definition_sha256,through_at,role_ids,context,opportunities,source_sha256)
 values(sw,p_session,mr.current_step_key,mr.control_version,rb.snapshot_sha256,cutoff,ids,ctx,opps,public.combat_v2_sha256(payload));
 insert into mission_generic_owner.work_items(id,master_session_id,event_id,dedupe_key,step_key,run_control_version,definition_sha256,authority_receipt_id,kind,revision,payload,payload_sha256)
 values(wid,p_session,sw,'director:'||sw,mr.current_step_key,mr.control_version,rb.snapshot_sha256,sw,'director',mr.control_version,payload,public.combat_v2_sha256(payload));
 update mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows set work_id=wid where id=sw;
 update mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_reissues
   set state='enqueued',new_window_id=sw,enqueued_at=clock_timestamp()
   where master_session_id=p_session and state='armed';
 return jsonb_build_object('work_id',wid,'state','director_ready');
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mission_generic_event_claim_v1(p_event_key uuid, p_event_version bigint, p_proof jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE e mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1;cfg jsonb;recover boolean:=false;request_key uuid;w mission_generic_owner.work_items;paid_recovery boolean:=false;terminal_reconcile boolean:=false;
BEGIN
 PERFORM mission_ai_board_owner.service_only();
 IF p_event_key IS NULL OR p_event_version IS NULL OR p_event_version<1 OR p_proof IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'EVENT42_WAKE_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 IF p_proof->>'schema_version'='mission-event-wake-proof/2' THEN
 IF NOT mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(p_proof,ARRAY['schema_version']) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'EVENT42_HINT_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 ELSIF p_proof->>'schema_version'='mission-event-recovery-proof/1' THEN
 IF NOT mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(p_proof,ARRAY['schema_version','authenticated_user','request_key'])
 OR coalesce(p_proof->>'authenticated_user','')!~'^[a-fA-F0-9]{8}(-[a-fA-F0-9]{4}){3}-[a-fA-F0-9]{12}$'
 OR coalesce(p_proof->>'request_key','')!~'^[a-fA-F0-9]{8}(-[a-fA-F0-9]{4}){3}-[a-fA-F0-9]{12}$'
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'EVENT42_RECOVERY_INVALID' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 recover:=true;request_key:=(p_proof->>'request_key')::uuid;
 ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'EVENT42_PROOF_REJECTED' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock_shared(hashtextextended('C1266:GENERIC-AI:AVAILABILITY',0));
 SELECT * INTO e FROM mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1
 WHERE event_key=p_event_key AND event_version=p_event_version FOR UPDATE;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'EVENT42_WAKE_REJECTED' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 IF NOT recover THEN
 IF e.claimed_at IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-event-claim/1',
 'event_key',e.event_key,'event_version',e.event_version,'status',CASE WHEN e.state='running' THEN 'busy' ELSE 'terminal' END);END IF;
 -- A superseded public wake is a redacted no-op: never retrogress private state/history.
 IF e.state='terminal' OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1 newer
 WHERE newer.event_key=e.event_key AND newer.event_version>e.event_version) THEN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-event-claim/1','event_key',e.event_key,'event_version',e.event_version,'status','terminal');END IF;
 ELSE
 -- p_proof is created by the JWT-authenticated Edge route only; this RPC is service_role-only.
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles ep WHERE ep.id=(p_proof->>'authenticated_user')::uuid AND ep.role IN('admin','master')) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'EVENT42_RECOVERY_STAFF' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 IF (p_proof->>'authenticated_user')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM e.root_principal THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'EVENT42_RECOVERY_OWNER' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 IF e.work_id IS NOT NULL THEN
 -- Admission snapshot only: never acquire work after event lock. The terminal work trigger
 -- may lock this event; claim must not wait on its work row. No native lease/result is changed
 -- here. Next rechecks actual state and calls the original locked/CAS recovery/claim port.
 SELECT * INTO STRICT w FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=e.work_id AND master_session_id=e.master_session_id;
 IF (mission_generic_owner.director_incomplete_reissue_proof_v1(w.id,e.root_principal)->'can_reissue'='true'::jsonb) IS TRUE THEN
  paid_recovery:=true;
 ELSIF mission_generic_owner.writer_count_reissue_proof_v1(w.id,e.root_principal) IS NOT NULL THEN
  paid_recovery:=true;
 ELSIF w.state='failed' AND w.kind='director' AND w.result->'failure_codes' ? 'MISSION_PROVIDER_OUTPUT_RETENTION_FAILED' THEN
 paid_recovery:=(mission_generic_owner.retained_director_adoption_v1(w.id,false)->>'owner_user_id'=e.root_principal::text) IS TRUE;
 ELSIF w.state='failed' AND w.kind='narration' AND w.result->'ok'='true'::jsonb
 AND w.result->>'provider_calls'='1' AND w.result->'outcome_uncertain'='false'::jsonb
 AND (w.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.result) OR EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit hp_finalized
 WHERE hp_finalized.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND hp_finalized.event_code='generic_finalized'
 AND hp_finalized.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text
 AND hp_finalized.details->>'receipt_id'=w.receipt_id::text
 AND hp_finalized.details->>'state'=w.state
 AND hp_finalized.details->'message_id' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM coalesce(to_jsonb(w.message_id),'null'::jsonb)
 AND hp_finalized.details->>'result_sha256'=w.result_sha256
 AND hp_finalized.details->>'result_jsonb_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.result))) THEN paid_recovery:=true;
 END IF;
 IF NOT paid_recovery AND w.state IN('completed','failed') AND w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
  AND (w.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.result) OR EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit hp_finalized
 WHERE hp_finalized.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND hp_finalized.event_code='generic_finalized'
 AND hp_finalized.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text
 AND hp_finalized.details->>'receipt_id'=w.receipt_id::text
 AND hp_finalized.details->>'state'=w.state
 AND hp_finalized.details->'message_id' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM coalesce(to_jsonb(w.message_id),'null'::jsonb)
 AND hp_finalized.details->>'result_sha256'=w.result_sha256
 AND hp_finalized.details->>'result_jsonb_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.result))) THEN
 terminal_reconcile:=true;END IF;
 IF NOT paid_recovery AND NOT terminal_reconcile AND (NOT(w.state='ready' AND w.lease_id IS NULL OR w.state='claimed' AND w.lease_id IS NOT NULL AND w.lease_expires_at<=clock_timestamp())
  OR w.authorization_id IS NOT NULL OR w.dispatch_id IS NOT NULL OR w.result IS NOT NULL OR w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL OR w.message_id IS NOT NULL
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations pa WHERE pa.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id)
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts da WHERE da.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id)
  OR(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a WHERE a.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND a.event_code='c8_count_started')
   AND NOT(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a WHERE a.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND a.event_code='c8_count_success'
     AND a.details->'generation_allowed'='true'::jsonb AND a.details->'generation_http_calls'='0'::jsonb)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a WHERE a.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND a.event_code='c8_count_unknown')))) THEN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-event-claim/1','event_key',e.event_key,'event_version',e.event_version,'status','busy');END IF;
 END IF;
 IF NOT terminal_reconcile AND e.state='running' AND e.claim_expires_at>clock_timestamp() THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-event-claim/1',
 'event_key',e.event_key,'event_version',e.event_version,'status','busy');END IF;
 END IF;
 SELECT rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>'{config,c1266_server_events}' INTO cfg
 FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness rr
 WHERE rr.singleton AND rr.state='enabled' AND rr.scope='staff'
 AND rr.revision_sha256=rr.observed_revision_sha256;
 IF cfg->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'c1266-server-events/1'
 OR cfg->'enabled' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'EVENT42_MODE_DISABLED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions m JOIN public.locations l ON l.id=m.location_id
 WHERE m.id=e.master_session_id AND m.owner_kind='ai_service' AND m.master_user IS NULL
 AND m.closed_at IS NULL AND m.suspended_at IS NULL AND m.stato IN('preparazione','in_corso')
 AND l.id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid AND l.is_test AND l.is_active)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id=e.root_principal AND p.role IN('admin','master'))
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.start_claims sc
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.board_starts bs ON bs.request_key=sc.request_key
 WHERE sc.request_key=e.root_request_key AND sc.actor_user_id=e.root_principal
 AND sc.session_id=e.master_session_id AND bs.master_session_id=e.master_session_id
 AND public.combat_v2_sha256(bs.result)=e.root_receipt_sha256)
 OR mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_scope_v1(e.master_session_id) IS NULL
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'EVENT42_SCOPE_REJECTED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;

 -- Trusted explicit recovery can acknowledge a proved already-finalized work. No lease,
 -- authorization, Count, Generation, progress or publication is created by this branch.
 IF recover AND terminal_reconcile THEN
  IF e.claim_id IS NULL OR e.canonical_request IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
   'schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',w.master_session_id,
   'event_id',w.event_id,'request_key',w.request_key,'expected_revision',w.revision)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'EVENT42_WORK_DRIFT' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
  IF e.state='terminal' AND e.settle_result->>'state'='terminal' THEN
   RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-event-claim/1','event_key',e.event_key,'event_version',e.event_version,'status','terminal');END IF;
  UPDATE mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1 SET state='terminal',claim_history=claim_history||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('claim_id',claim_id,'expires_at',claim_expires_at,'state',state,'recovery_request_key',recovery_request_key,'settle_result',settle_result,'next_result_sha256',CASE WHEN next_result IS NOT NULL THEN public.combat_v2_sha256(next_result) ELSE NULL END)),
   recovery_request_key=request_key,settle_result=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-event-settle/1',
    'event_key',event_key,'event_version',event_version,'claim_id',claim_id,'master_session_id',master_session_id,'state','terminal'),
   updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE event_key=e.event_key AND event_version=e.event_version;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-event-claim/1','event_key',e.event_key,'event_version',e.event_version,'status','terminal');
 END IF;

 UPDATE mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1 SET state='running',claim_history=claim_history||CASE WHEN claim_id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('claim_id',claim_id,'expires_at',claim_expires_at,'state',state,'recovery_request_key',recovery_request_key,'settle_result',settle_result,'next_result_sha256',CASE WHEN next_result IS NOT NULL THEN public.combat_v2_sha256(next_result) ELSE NULL END)) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,recovery_request_key=CASE WHEN recover THEN request_key ELSE NULL END,settle_result=NULL,next_result=CASE WHEN recover THEN NULL ELSE next_result END,claim_id=pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid(),
 claimed_at=clock_timestamp(),claim_expires_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '400 seconds',updated_at=clock_timestamp()
 WHERE event_key=e.event_key AND event_version=e.event_version RETURNING * INTO e;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-event-claim/1','event_key',e.event_key,'event_version',e.event_version,
 'status','claimed','claim_id',e.claim_id,'master_session_id',e.master_session_id,'principal_user',e.root_principal,
 'mode','staff_simulation','scope_location','0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b','expires_at',e.claim_expires_at);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mission_generic_room_state_v1(p_location uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare uid uuid:=auth.uid();m public.master_v2_sessions;r public.mission_run_state;vchoices jsonb;
 staff boolean;participant boolean;objective text;active boolean; uf_work mission_generic_owner.work_items;uf_processing jsonb;uf_rounds jsonb;uf_progress_key text;uf_state text;uf_marker jsonb;uf_review boolean;
 academy boolean;flow_state text;flow_publication uuid;role_diag jsonb;
 private_source_step text;private_pending boolean:=false;combat_recovery jsonb;
 staff_tick_view jsonb:=NULL;st_revision text;st_tick mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1;st_receipt mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts;
 st_work record;st_source record;st_dispatch jsonb;st_next_key uuid;st_original_key uuid;st_owner boolean:=false;
 st_valid boolean:=false;st_released boolean:=false;st_blocked boolean:=false;st_resume boolean:=false;
 st_ack_predecessor uuid:=NULL;st_candidate_predecessor uuid:=NULL;
 st_depth integer:=0;st_state text;st_public_state text;st_recovery uuid;st_effective_id uuid;
 st_budget_a mission_generic_owner.dispatch_admissions;st_budget_g mission_generic_owner.provider_policy;st_budget_p record;
 mb_read_recovery boolean:=false;mb_mode boolean:=false; st_spent numeric;st_http bigint;st_bound numeric;st_cap_cost numeric;st_cap_http integer;st_budget_ok boolean:=false;
 opening_resume49 jsonb:=NULL;opening_claim_resume6 jsonb:=NULL;
 journal_settlements jsonb:=NULL;
 retained_handoff jsonb:=NULL;retained_row record;
 c26_count_view jsonb:=NULL;c26_driver jsonb:=NULL;c26_proof jsonb;c26_kind text;c26_revision text;c26_phase_kind text;
  nw_original_sha text;nw_original_key uuid;nw_mode boolean:=false;
 budget1_effective numeric;budget1_policy numeric;
 role_command_capability jsonb:=NULL;role_command_enabled boolean:=false;event42_mode boolean:=false;
begin
 if uid is null then raise exception 'authentication_required' using errcode='28000';end if;
 staff:=exists(select 1 from public.profiles where id=uid and role in('admin','master'));
 select s.* into m from public.master_v2_sessions s join mission_generic_owner.run_bindings b on b.master_session_id=s.id
 where s.location_id=p_location and s.closed_at is null and s.owner_kind='ai_service'
 and (staff or exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants p join public.characters c on c.id=p.character_id and c.user_id=uid
  where p.session_id=s.id and p.user_id_snapshot=uid and p.left_at is null)) order by s.created_at desc limit 1;
 if m.id is null then return null;end if;
 perform mission_generic_owner.assert_runtime(m.id);
 select * into strict r from public.mission_run_state where master_session_id=m.id;
 select sw.step_key into private_source_step from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches pending_batch
 join mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw on sw.id=pending_batch.source_window_id
 where pending_batch.master_session_id=m.id AND pending_batch.composition_kind='entry_png'
   AND pending_batch.state IN('preparing','ready') AND pending_batch.retired_at IS NULL AND pending_batch.message_id IS NULL
   AND pending_batch.encounter_id IS NOT NULL
 order by pending_batch.created_at desc,pending_batch.id desc limit 1;
 private_pending:=private_source_step IS NOT NULL;
 participant:=exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants p join public.characters c on c.id=p.character_id and c.user_id=uid
 where p.session_id=m.id and p.user_id_snapshot=uid and p.left_at is null);
 event42_mode:=EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1 mode42 WHERE mode42.master_session_id=m.id AND mode42.event_domain='start');
 -- Quest uses its own native source (mission_id is NULL). No private context is emitted.
 academy:=mission_creation_owner.director_context(m.id,r.current_step_key) is not null
 or exists(select 1 from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources qs
   join public.mission_plan_versions pv on pv.id=qs.plan_version_id
   join public.mission_plans qp on qp.id=pv.plan_id
   join mission_generic_owner.run_bindings qb on qb.master_session_id=qs.session_id
   join mission_generic_owner.definitions qd on qd.id=qb.definition_id
   join public.locations ql on ql.id=qs.location_id
   where qs.session_id=m.id and qs.state in('prepared','opening_pending','uncertain','started')
    and m.mission_id is null and m.tipo='quest' and qs.location_id=m.location_id
    and qs.plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id and qp.source_kind='quest'
    and qp.quest_episode_id=qs.episode_id and qp.quest_source_sha256=qs.source_sha256
    and qd.id=qs.definition_id and qd.plan_version_id=qs.plan_version_id
    and qd.plan_sha256=r.plan_sha256 and qb.snapshot_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(qb.snapshot)
    and qd.definition_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(qd.definition)
    and ql.id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid and ql.is_active and ql.is_test);
 select public_objective into objective from public.mission_plan_steps where plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id
   and step_key=coalesce(private_source_step,r.current_step_key);
 if participant and not academy then vchoices:=public.mission_generic_choices_v1(m.id);
 else vchoices:=jsonb_build_object('choices','[]'::jsonb);end if;
 active:=m.stato in('preparazione','in_corso') and m.suspended_at is null and r.run_phase in('preparazione','in_corso');
 -- Public metadata only; no work payload, private intent, role or provider configuration.
 WITH room_session_source_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT room_source.id,room_source.work_id
  FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows room_source
  WHERE room_source.master_session_id=m.id
 ), room_released_sources AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT room_source_row.id,room_source_row.work_id
  FROM room_session_source_rows room_source_row
  WHERE mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(room_source_row.id)
 )
 select uf_candidate.* into uf_work from mission_generic_owner.work_items uf_candidate
where uf_candidate.master_session_id=m.id
 and not exists(
   select 1 from room_released_sources superseded_role
   left join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches superseded_batch
     on superseded_batch.source_window_id=superseded_role.id
   where (superseded_role.work_id=uf_candidate.id
       or superseded_batch.writer_work_id=uf_candidate.id))
 and not (m.id='b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
   and mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(m.id)
   and exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows superseded
     where superseded.id=uf_candidate.id and superseded.superseded_at is not null))
 and not (
  m.id='93d78313-abde-4087-9eb7-7b96bc0fa089'::uuid
  and m.location_id='6c737082-8fc7-4fd8-b246-30297a1ed1af'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.id='3076c471-37c5-438e-8f50-0a790b787e05'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.kind='choice' and uf_candidate.state='failed'
  and uf_candidate.encounter_id='deadfef6-5b16-4921-aa86-b86ffad6f2f2'::uuid

 JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds event43_round ON event43_round.id=event43_src.round_id
 JOIN public.combat_v2_round_reports event43_report
  ON event43_report.id=event43_round.report_id AND event43_report.round_id=event43_round.id
 JOIN public.combat_v2_sessions event43_enc ON event43_enc.id=event43_round.session_id
  AND event43_enc.master_session_id=es.master_session_id AND event43_enc.location_id=m.location_id
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches event43_batch
  ON event43_batch.master_session_id=es.master_session_id AND event43_batch.encounter_id=event43_enc.id
  AND event43_batch.source_round_id=event43_round.id AND event43_batch.source_report_id=event43_report.id
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.work_items event43_w ON event43_w.id=event43_batch.writer_work_id
  AND event43_w.event_id=event43_batch.id AND event43_w.authority_receipt_id=event43_batch.id
  AND event43_w.master_session_id=es.master_session_id AND event43_w.encounter_id=event43_enc.id
 JOIN public.messages event43_msg ON event43_msg.id=event43_w.message_id AND event43_msg.location_id=m.location_id
 WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM event43_sources)=1
 AND es.event_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(event43_round.id,'server-event:native-input')
 AND es.created_at<=event43_batch.created_at
 AND ((es.work_id IS NULL AND es.canonical_request IS NULL) OR (es.work_id=event43_w.id
  AND es.canonical_request=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1',
  'master_session_id',event43_w.master_session_id,'event_id',event43_w.event_id,
  'request_key',event43_w.request_key,'expected_revision',event43_w.revision)))
 AND event43_w.kind='narration' AND event43_w.state='completed' AND event43_w.result->'ok'='true'::jsonb
 AND event43_w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND event43_w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
 AND event43_batch.state='published' AND event43_batch.published_at IS NOT NULL AND event43_batch.retired_at IS NULL
 AND event43_report.narration_state='pubblicata' AND event43_report.message_id=event43_msg.id
 AND event43_batch.message_id=event43_msg.id AND event43_msg.kind='fato' AND event43_msg.recipient_user IS NULL
 AND event43_report.mechanics_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(event43_report.mechanics)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(event43_report.mechanics->'declarations') event43_dec
  WHERE event43_dec->>'id'=event43_src.declaration_id::text)
 AND (event43_src.coverage_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(event43_report.mechanics->'defense_coverages') event43_cov
  WHERE event43_cov->>'id'=event43_src.coverage_id::text))
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1 event43_done
  WHERE event43_done.master_session_id=es.master_session_id AND event43_done.event_key=es.event_key
  AND event43_done.event_domain='native_input' AND event43_done.state='terminal'
  AND event43_done.root_event_key=es.root_event_key AND event43_done.root_event_version=es.root_event_version
  AND event43_done.root_request_key=es.root_request_key AND event43_done.root_principal=es.root_principal
  AND event43_done.root_receipt_sha256=es.root_receipt_sha256
  AND event43_done.work_id=event43_w.id
  AND event43_done.canonical_request=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1',
  'master_session_id',event43_w.master_session_id,'event_id',event43_w.event_id,
  'request_key',event43_w.request_key,'expected_revision',event43_w.revision))
 AND (event43_w.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(event43_w.result) OR EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit event43_final
  WHERE event43_final.receipt_id=event43_w.dispatch_receipt_id AND event43_final.event_code='generic_finalized'
  AND event43_final.details->>'work_id'=event43_w.id::text
  AND event43_final.details->>'receipt_id'=event43_w.receipt_id::text
  AND event43_final.details->>'state'=event43_w.state
  AND event43_final.details->'message_id'=to_jsonb(event43_msg.id)
  AND event43_final.details->>'result_sha256'=event43_w.result_sha256
  AND event43_final.details->>'result_jsonb_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(event43_w.result)))
 )
 ),FALSE)

 ORDER BY es.created_at DESC,es.event_key DESC,es.event_version DESC LIMIT 1),
 'retained_director_handoff',retained_handoff,'combat_narration_recovery',combat_recovery,'staff_finish',mission_generic_owner.staff_finish_status_v1(m.id,uid),'processing',uf_processing,'progress_key',uf_progress_key,'review_required',uf_review,
 'flow_state',flow_state,'flow_publication_id',flow_publication,
 'choices',case when uf_review or academy then '[]'::jsonb else vchoices->'choices' end,
 'choice_context',vchoices-'choices','state',m.stato,'can_tick',active and not uf_review AND NOT event42_mode
    and m.id<>'b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid,
 'request',case when active and not uf_review AND NOT event42_mode
    and m.id<>'b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid and not exists(
    select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c where c.master_session_id=m.id)
    then jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-tick/1','master_session_id',m.id) else null end)||coalesce(role_diag,'{}'::jsonb)||CASE WHEN staff_tick_view IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('staff_tick_status',staff_tick_view) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END||CASE WHEN c26_driver IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('driver_state',c26_driver) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END||CASE WHEN c26_count_view IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('count_reconciliation',c26_count_view) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END||CASE WHEN opening_resume49 IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('opening_ready_resume',opening_resume49) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END||CASE WHEN opening_claim_resume6 IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('opening_claim_resume',opening_claim_resume6) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END||CASE WHEN journal_settlements IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('journal_settlements',journal_settlements) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END||CASE WHEN role_command_capability IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('role_submit_capability',role_command_capability) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.staff_journal_settlements_v1(p_session uuid, p_user uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;verified_manual jsonb;manual_count_none boolean;writer46_item jsonb;writer46_items jsonb;
BEGIN
 -- This private reader is called only from the already authenticated room projection.
 -- Settled collective publications are readable by each current Staff participant;
 -- they confer no owner, retry, claim, tick, provider or gameplay authority.
 IF p_session IS NULL OR p_user IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions s JOIN public.locations l ON l.id=s.location_id
  JOIN public.master_v2_participants mp ON mp.session_id=s.id AND mp.user_id_snapshot=p_user
   AND mp.left_at IS NULL AND mp.engagement_state='attivo'
  JOIN public.characters ch ON ch.id=mp.character_id AND ch.user_id=mp.user_id_snapshot
  JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.id=p_user AND pr.role IN('admin','master')
  WHERE s.id=p_session AND s.owner_kind='ai_service' AND s.master_user IS NULL
   AND s.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid
   AND l.is_active AND l.is_test AND s.closed_at IS NULL AND s.suspended_at IS NULL
   AND s.stato='in_corso')
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 verified_manual:=mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_scope_v1(p_session);
 IF verified_manual IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 -- Stable policy proof evaluated once for this read, never per joined receipt.
 manual_count_none:=mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_count_limit_v1(p_session)='none';
 WITH retained_candidates AS MATERIALIZED(
 SELECT rdjournal.* FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items rdjournal
 WHERE rdjournal.master_session_id=p_session AND rdjournal.kind='director' AND rdjournal.state='failed'
  AND rdjournal.result->'failure_codes' ? 'MISSION_PROVIDER_OUTPUT_RETENTION_FAILED'
 ), retained_published AS MATERIALIZED(
 SELECT rdjournalproof.proof->'request' request,rdjournal.id work_id,rdjournal.receipt_id,rdjournal.result_sha256,
  jsonb_build_object('writer_work_id',rdchild.id,'message_id',rdchild.message_id,
   'receipt_id',rdchild.receipt_id,'result_sha256',rdchild.result_sha256) publication
 FROM retained_candidates rdjournal
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT mission_generic_owner.retained_director_adoption_v1(rdjournal.id,true) proof) rdjournalproof
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.work_items rdchild ON rdchild.id=(rdjournalproof.proof#>>'{applied,child_work_id}')::uuid
 WHERE rdjournalproof.proof IS NOT NULL
 ), carry_parents AS MATERIALIZED(
 SELECT cp24_work.id work_id,cp24_work.receipt_id,cp24_work.result_sha256,cp24_work.payload_sha256,cp24_contract.contract_sha256,cp24_source.id source_id,cp24_source.role_ids,
  cp24_work.step_key parent_step_key,cp24_work.run_control_version parent_control_version,
  cp24_work.definition_sha256 parent_definition_sha256,
  cp24_contract.contract#>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,admission}' parent_admission,
  cp24_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,financial_qualification_sha256}' parent_financial_sha256,
  cp24_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,c7_budget_qualification_sha256}' parent_c7_sha256,
  cp24_source.context->>'source_revision' source_revision,cp24_release_audit.details,
  jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',cp24_work.master_session_id,
   'event_id',cp24_work.event_id,'request_key',cp24_work.request_key,'expected_revision',cp24_work.revision) request
 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items cp24_work
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows cp24_source ON cp24_source.id=cp24_work.authority_receipt_id
 JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts cp24_dispatch ON cp24_dispatch.id=cp24_work.dispatch_receipt_id
 JOIN mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 cp24_contract ON cp24_contract.work_id=cp24_work.id
 JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit cp24_release_audit ON cp24_release_audit.receipt_id=cp24_dispatch.id
 WHERE cp24_work.master_session_id=p_session AND cp24_source.superseded_reason='staff_failed_director_validation_retry'
  AND cp24_work.kind='director' AND cp24_work.state='failed' AND cp24_work.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
 AND cp24_work.message_id IS NULL AND cp24_work.receipt_id IS NOT NULL
 AND cp24_work.authorization_id IS NULL AND cp24_work.dispatch_id IS NULL
 AND cp24_work.payload->>'schema_version' IN('mission-director-work/3','mission-director-work/4')
 AND cp24_work.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-pre-provider-failure/1'
 AND cp24_work.result->>'failure_code'='request_validation_failed'
 AND cp24_work.result->'ok'='false'::jsonb AND cp24_work.result->'provider_calls'='0'::jsonb
 AND cp24_work.result->'charged_cost_usd'='0'::jsonb
 AND cp24_work.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(cp24_work.payload)
 AND cp24_work.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(cp24_work.result)
 AND cp24_work.id=cp24_source.id AND cp24_source.work_id=cp24_work.id AND cp24_source.master_session_id=cp24_work.master_session_id
 AND cp24_source.source_sha256=cp24_work.payload_sha256 AND cp24_source.definition_sha256=cp24_work.definition_sha256
 AND cp24_source.context->>'source_revision'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
 AND cp24_dispatch.id=cp24_work.dispatch_receipt_id AND cp24_dispatch.master_session_id=cp24_work.master_session_id
 AND cp24_dispatch.authority_receipt_id=cp24_work.id AND cp24_dispatch.request_key=cp24_work.request_key
 AND cp24_dispatch.status='failed' AND cp24_dispatch.dispatch_count=0 AND cp24_dispatch.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
 AND cp24_dispatch.charged_cost_usd=0 AND cp24_dispatch.upper_bound_cost_usd=0
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts cp24_evidence WHERE cp24_evidence.receipt_id=cp24_dispatch.id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations cp24_evidence WHERE cp24_evidence.receipt_id=cp24_dispatch.id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls cp24_evidence WHERE cp24_evidence.source_id=cp24_dispatch.id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit cp24_evidence WHERE cp24_evidence.receipt_id=cp24_dispatch.id AND cp24_evidence.event_code LIKE 'c8_count_%')
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit cp24_evidence
  WHERE cp24_evidence.receipt_id=cp24_dispatch.id AND cp24_evidence.event_code='generic_pre_provider_failed'
   AND cp24_evidence.details->>'work_id'=cp24_work.id::text AND cp24_evidence.details->>'receipt_id'=cp24_work.receipt_id::text
   AND cp24_evidence.details->>'failure_code'='request_validation_failed'
   AND cp24_evidence.details->>'result_sha256'=cp24_work.result_sha256
   AND cp24_evidence.details->'provider_calls'='0'::jsonb AND cp24_evidence.details->'charged_cost_usd'='0'::jsonb)
 AND cp24_contract.work_id=cp24_work.id AND cp24_contract.master_session_id=cp24_work.master_session_id AND cp24_contract.scope='staff_mission'
 AND cp24_contract.definition_sha256=cp24_work.definition_sha256 AND cp24_contract.payload_sha256=cp24_work.payload_sha256
 AND cp24_contract.contract_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(cp24_contract.contract)
 AND cp24_contract.contract->>'schema_version'='mission-narrative-admission/3'
 AND cp24_contract.contract->'features' ?& ARRAY['execution_authority_v1','role_intents_v2','native_intent_resolution_v1']
 AND (cp24_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,work_id}',cp24_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,master_session_id}',cp24_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,definition_sha256}',cp24_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,payload_sha256}',cp24_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,release_sha256}',cp24_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,authority_receipt_id}')
  IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (cp24_work.id::text,cp24_work.master_session_id::text,cp24_work.definition_sha256,cp24_work.payload_sha256,cp24_contract.release_sha256,cp24_work.authority_receipt_id::text)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items cp24_carry
  JOIN mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 cp24_carry_contract ON cp24_carry_contract.work_id=cp24_carry.id
  JOIN public.messages cp24_message ON cp24_message.id=cp24_carry.message_id AND cp24_message.kind='fato' AND cp24_message.recipient_user IS NULL AND cp24_message.body=cp24_carry.result->>'text'
  WHERE cp24_carry.master_session_id=cp24_work.master_session_id AND cp24_carry.kind='narration' AND cp24_carry.state='completed'
   AND cp24_carry.id::text=cp24_work.payload#>>'{context,continuity,work_id}'
   AND cp24_carry.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-narration/4'
   AND cp24_carry.result->'continuity' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ((cp24_work.payload#>'{context,continuity}') - 'covered_message_id')
   AND cp24_work.payload#>>'{context,continuity,covered_message_id}'=cp24_carry.message_id::text
   AND cp24_carry_contract.master_session_id=cp24_carry.master_session_id AND cp24_carry_contract.definition_sha256=cp24_carry.definition_sha256
   AND cp24_carry_contract.payload_sha256=cp24_carry.payload_sha256 AND cp24_carry.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(cp24_carry.payload)
   AND cp24_carry_contract.contract_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(cp24_carry_contract.contract)
   AND cp24_carry.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(cp24_carry.result)
   AND cp24_carry_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,work_id}'=cp24_carry.id::text
   AND cp24_carry_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,master_session_id}'=cp24_carry.master_session_id::text
   AND cp24_carry_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,payload_sha256}'=cp24_carry.payload_sha256
   AND cp24_carry_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,definition_sha256}'=cp24_carry.definition_sha256
   AND cp24_carry_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,release_sha256}'=cp24_carry_contract.release_sha256
   AND cp24_carry_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,authority_receipt_id}'=cp24_carry.authority_receipt_id::text
   AND cp24_carry_contract.contract->'features' ? 'free_narrative_v1') AND cp24_release_audit.event_code='staff_failed_director_validation_retry'
 AND cp24_release_audit.details->>'attestation_schema'='mission-continuity-carry-release/1'
 AND cp24_release_audit.details->>'master_session_id'=cp24_work.master_session_id::text
 AND cp24_release_audit.details->>'work_id'=cp24_work.id::text AND cp24_release_audit.details->>'source_window_id'=cp24_source.id::text
 AND cp24_release_audit.details->>'payload_sha256'=cp24_work.payload_sha256 AND cp24_release_audit.details->>'result_sha256'=cp24_work.result_sha256
 AND cp24_release_audit.details->>'contract_sha256'=cp24_contract.contract_sha256
 AND cp24_release_audit.details->>'role_ids_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(cp24_source.role_ids))
 AND cp24_release_audit.details->>'source_revision'=cp24_source.context->>'source_revision'
 AND cp24_release_audit.details->>'fixed_release_sha256'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
 AND cp24_release_audit.details->>'fixed_source_sha256'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
 AND cp24_release_audit.details->>'successor_progress_key'=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(cp24_work.id,'mission-staff-released-director-retry/1:'||(cp24_source.context->>'source_revision'))::text
 AND cp24_release_audit.details->'provider_calls'='0'::jsonb AND cp24_release_audit.details->'charged_cost_usd'='0'::jsonb
 AND cp24_release_audit.details->'historical_work_preserved'='true'::jsonb
 UNION ALL
 SELECT co39_parent.id,co39_parent.receipt_id,co39_parent.result_sha256,co39_parent.payload_sha256,co39_contract.contract_sha256,co39_source.id,co39_source.role_ids,
  co39_parent.step_key,co39_parent.run_control_version,co39_parent.definition_sha256,
  co39_contract.contract#>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,admission}',
  co39_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,financial_qualification_sha256}',
  co39_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,c7_budget_qualification_sha256}',
  co39_source.context->>'source_revision',co39_release.details,
  jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',co39_parent.master_session_id,
   'event_id',co39_parent.event_id,'request_key',co39_parent.request_key,'expected_revision',co39_parent.revision)
 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items co39_parent
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows co39_source ON co39_source.id=co39_parent.authority_receipt_id
 JOIN mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 co39_contract ON co39_contract.work_id=co39_parent.id
 JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit co39_release ON co39_release.receipt_id=co39_parent.dispatch_receipt_id AND co39_release.event_code='staff_failed_director_count_overflow_retry'
 WHERE co39_parent.master_session_id=p_session AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items co39_w
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows co39_s ON co39_s.id=co39_w.authority_receipt_id AND co39_s.work_id=co39_w.id AND co39_s.master_session_id=co39_w.master_session_id
 JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts co39_d ON co39_d.id=co39_w.dispatch_receipt_id
 JOIN mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 co39_c ON co39_c.work_id=co39_w.id
 JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit co39_a ON co39_a.receipt_id=co39_d.id AND co39_a.event_code='staff_failed_director_count_overflow_retry'
 JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit co39_t ON co39_t.receipt_id=co39_d.id AND co39_t.event_code='c1266_count_terminal'
 JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit co39_start ON co39_start.receipt_id=co39_d.id AND co39_start.event_code='c8_count_started'
 JOIN mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit co39_finish ON co39_finish.receipt_id=co39_d.id AND co39_finish.event_code='c8_count_success'
 JOIN staff_ai_quota_private.calls co39_q ON co39_q.id::text=co39_start.details->>'shared_count_ticket'
 WHERE co39_s.id=co39_source.id AND co39_w.kind='director' AND co39_w.state='failed'
 AND co39_w.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-director-work/4'
 AND co39_w.finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND co39_w.receipt_id IS NOT NULL AND co39_w.message_id IS NULL
 AND co39_w.authorization_id IS NULL AND co39_w.dispatch_id IS NULL
 AND co39_w.result->>'schema_version'='c1266-count-terminal-failure/1'
 AND co39_w.result->>'failure_code'='MISSION_INPUT_COUNT_OVERFLOW'
 AND co39_w.result->'failure_codes'='["MISSION_INPUT_COUNT_OVERFLOW"]'::jsonb
 AND co39_w.result->'ok'='false'::jsonb AND co39_w.result->'generation_http_calls'='0'::jsonb
 AND co39_w.result->'count_http_calls'='1'::jsonb AND co39_w.result->'provider_calls'='0'::jsonb
 AND co39_w.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(co39_w.result)
 AND co39_w.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(co39_w.payload)
 AND co39_s.id=co39_w.id
 AND co39_s.source_sha256=co39_w.payload_sha256 AND co39_s.definition_sha256=co39_w.definition_sha256
 AND co39_s.step_key=co39_w.step_key AND co39_s.run_control_version=co39_w.run_control_version
 AND co39_s.superseded_at IS NOT NULL AND co39_s.superseded_reason='staff_failed_director_count_overflow_retry'
 AND co39_s.consumed_message_id IS NULL AND cardinality(co39_s.role_ids)=2
 AND co39_s.context->>'source_revision'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
 AND co39_d.master_session_id=co39_w.master_session_id AND co39_d.authority_receipt_id=co39_w.id
 AND co39_d.request_key=co39_w.request_key AND co39_d.status='failed' AND co39_d.finalized_at IS NOT NULL
 AND co39_d.dispatch_count=0 AND co39_d.charged_cost_usd=0 AND co39_d.upper_bound_cost_usd IS NULL
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts co39_da WHERE co39_da.receipt_id=co39_d.id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations co39_pa WHERE co39_pa.receipt_id=co39_d.id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls co39_g WHERE co39_g.source_id=co39_d.id AND co39_g.scope_id=co39_w.master_session_id AND co39_g.call_no=1)
 AND co39_c.master_session_id=co39_w.master_session_id AND co39_c.scope='staff_mission'

   AND s.stato='in_corso')
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;

  jsonb_build_object('writer_work_id',rdchild.id,'message_id',rdchild.message_id,

    WHERE bs.master_session_id=p_session AND bs.id=w.event_id AND bs.id=w.authority_receipt_id
     AND bs.id::text=w.payload->>'opening_start_receipt_id' AND bs.state='published' AND bs.published_at IS NOT NULL
     AND bs.result->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text AND bs.result->>'event_id'=bs.event_id::text
     AND bs.result->>'start_receipt_id'=bs.id::text
     AND pub.context_fingerprint=bs.result->>'context_fingerprint' AND ob.context_fingerprint=pub.context_fingerprint
     AND pub.status='committed'
     AND pub.body_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(msg.body,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')))
 ), carry_published AS MATERIALIZED(
 SELECT parent.request,parent.work_id,parent.receipt_id,parent.result_sha256,parent.source_revision,
  jsonb_build_object('writer_work_id',pub.writer_work_id,'message_id',pub.message_id,

 FROM carry_parent_proofs parent
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts successor_progress
  ON successor_progress.master_session_id=p_session
   AND successor_progress.request_key::text=parent.details->>'successor_progress_key'
   AND successor_progress.actor_user_id::text=parent.details->>'actor_user_id'
   AND successor_progress.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(successor_progress.result)
   AND successor_progress.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-progress/1'
   AND successor_progress.result->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text
 JOIN qualified child ON child.kind='director' AND child.state='completed'
  AND child.request=successor_progress.result->'dispatch'
 JOIN mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 child_contract ON child_contract.work_id=child.id
  AND child_contract.master_session_id=p_session AND child_contract.definition_sha256=child.definition_sha256
  AND child_contract.payload_sha256=child.payload_sha256
  AND child_contract.contract_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(child_contract.contract)
  AND (child_contract.release_sha256=parent.details->>'fixed_release_sha256'
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit cp25_witness

     AND cp25_witness.details->>'schema_version'='mission-continuity-parent-root-transition/1'
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'deployment_kind'='reviewed_atomic_root_installation'
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'witness_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(cp25_witness.details-'witness_sha256')
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'parent_work_id'=parent.work_id::text

     AND cp25_witness.details->>'source_window_id'=parent.source_id::text
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'source_revision'=parent.source_revision
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'role_ids_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(parent.role_ids))
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'definition_sha256'=parent.parent_definition_sha256
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'step_key'=parent.parent_step_key

     AND cp25_witness.details->>'recipe_sha256'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'source_review_sha256'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'

      IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (child.id::text,p_session::text,child.definition_sha256,child.payload_sha256,child_contract.release_sha256,child.authority_receipt_id::text)

   ))
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows child_source ON child_source.id=child.authority_receipt_id

  AND child_source.step_key=parent.parent_step_key AND child_source.run_control_version=parent.parent_control_version

  AND child_batch.decision_work_id=child.id AND child_batch.master_session_id=p_session
  AND child_batch.state='published' AND child_batch.published_at IS NOT NULL AND child_batch.retired_at IS NULL

 ), settled_raw AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.request,w.id AS work_id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,
   jsonb_build_object('writer_work_id',p.writer_work_id,'message_id',p.message_id,'receipt_id',p.receipt_id,'result_sha256',p.result_sha256) AS publication

  FROM qualified w
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.work_id=w.id AND sw.id=w.authority_receipt_id

  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub ON ub.source_window_id=sw.id AND ub.decision_work_id=w.id
   AND ub.master_session_id=p_session AND ub.state='published' AND ub.published_at IS NOT NULL
   AND ub.message_id=sw.consumed_message_id
  JOIN published p ON p.writer_work_id=ub.writer_work_id AND p.message_id=sw.consumed_message_id
  WHERE w.kind='director'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w.request,w.id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,
   jsonb_build_object('writer_work_id',p.writer_work_id,'message_id',p.message_id,'receipt_id',p.receipt_id,'result_sha256',p.result_sha256)
  FROM qualified w
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.panel_choices pc ON pc.work_id=w.id AND pc.id=(w.payload->>'capability_id')::uuid
   AND pc.master_session_id=p_session AND pc.encounter_id=w.encounter_id

   AND pc.consumed_at IS NOT NULL AND pc.legal_options=w.payload->'legal_options'

  CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT combat_panel_private.validate_command(w.result->'command') command) canonical
  JOIN combat_panel_private.offers offer ON offer.id=(canonical.command->>'offer_id')::uuid
   AND offer.principal_user=pc.principal_id AND offer.actor_id=pc.actor_id
   AND offer.state='consumed' AND offer.consumed_request_key=pc.request_key
  JOIN combat_panel_private.request_receipts native_receipt
   ON native_receipt.principal_user=pc.principal_id AND native_receipt.request_key=pc.request_key
   AND native_receipt.offer_id=offer.id AND native_receipt.viewer_envelope=pc.result

    CASE WHEN offer.kind='control' AND offer.source_payload='{"adapter":"master_v2","dispatch":"master_movement_control"}'::jsonb

  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows choice_window ON choice_window.round_id=choice_round.id

  JOIN public.combat_v2_round_reports choice_report ON choice_report.round_id=choice_round.id

   AND choice_report.values_written IS FALSE
   AND choice_report.mechanics_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(choice_report.mechanics)
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_report_publications choice_publication
   ON choice_publication.round_id=choice_round.id AND choice_publication.report_id=choice_report.id
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches publication_batch ON publication_batch.id=choice_publication.batch_id

   AND publication_batch.state='published' AND publication_batch.published_at IS NOT NULL AND publication_batch.retired_at IS NULL
   AND publication_batch.message_id=choice_publication.message_id
   AND ((choice_publication.primary_report AND publication_batch.source_report_id=choice_report.id
      AND publication_batch.source_round_id=choice_round.id AND choice_report.message_id=publication_batch.message_id)
    OR(NOT choice_publication.primary_report AND publication_batch.secondary_report_id=choice_report.id
      AND choice_report.message_id IS NULL))
  JOIN published p ON p.writer_work_id=publication_batch.writer_work_id AND p.message_id=publication_batch.message_id
   AND choice_window.publication_id=p.message_id
  WHERE w.kind='choice'
   AND pc.command_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(canonical.command)
   AND canonical.command->>'request_key'=pc.request_key::text
   AND canonical.command->>'activity_id'=pc.encounter_id::text
   AND canonical.command->'context_version'=to_jsonb(pc.context_version)
   AND pc.result#>>'{receipt,request_key}'=pc.request_key::text
   AND pc.result#>>'{receipt,activity_id}'=pc.encounter_id::text
   AND pc.result#>>'{receipt,round_id}'=choice_round.id::text
   AND pc.result#>'{receipt,values_written}'='false'::jsonb
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit finalized
    WHERE finalized.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND finalized.event_code='generic_finalized'
     AND finalized.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND finalized.details->>'receipt_id'=w.receipt_id::text
     AND finalized.details->>'result_sha256'=w.result_sha256

   AND (
    -- Ordinary native declarations must occur in the exact published report.
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_declarations decl

  UNION ALL SELECT request,work_id,receipt_id,result_sha256,publication FROM retained_published
