   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_segment_publications_v4 healed_pub WHERE healed_pub.work_id=healed_writer.id AND healed_pub.message_id=healed_msg.id)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls healed_q WHERE healed_q.producer='mission_generic_ai' AND healed_q.scope_id=p_session AND healed_q.source_id=healed_dr.id AND healed_q.call_no=1 AND healed_q.state='settled' AND healed_q.charged_usd=healed_dr.charged_cost_usd)))))
      AND pr.request_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(t.request_key,'mission-staff-no-dispatch-resume/1:'||t.source_revision))

    OR EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM released rel
     JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts original_pr ON original_pr.request_key=t.request_key
      AND original_pr.master_session_id=p_session AND original_pr.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id
      AND original_pr.result_sha256=t.result_sha256
      AND original_pr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(original_pr.result)
      AND original_pr.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-progress/1'
      AND original_pr.result->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text
      AND original_pr.result->'dispatch'=rel.request
     WHERE rel.source_revision=t.source_revision
      AND pr.request_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(rel.work_id,
       'mission-staff-released-director-retry/1:'||t.source_revision)))
   AND pr.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-progress/1' AND pr.result->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text
  JOIN settled s ON s.request=pr.result->'dispatch'
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.work_id=s.work_id AND sw.master_session_id=p_session
   AND sw.context->>'source_revision'=t.source_revision AND sw.consumed_message_id=(s.publication->>'message_id')::uuid
  WHERE t.master_session_id=p_session AND t.source_revision ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id=t.staff_user_id AND p.role IN('admin','master'))

  UNION ALL
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','request','request',rel.request),
   'request',rel.request,'work_id',rel.work_id,'receipt_id',rel.receipt_id,'result_sha256',rel.result_sha256,'release',rel.release)
  FROM released rel
  UNION ALL
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','staff_tick','source_revision',t.source_revision),
   'request',rel.request,'work_id',rel.work_id,'receipt_id',rel.receipt_id,'result_sha256',rel.result_sha256,'release',rel.release)
  FROM released rel
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1 t ON t.master_session_id=p_session AND t.source_revision=rel.source_revision
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts pr ON pr.request_key=t.request_key
   AND pr.master_session_id=p_session AND pr.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id
   AND pr.result_sha256=t.result_sha256 AND pr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(pr.result)
   AND (pr.result->'dispatch'=rel.request OR (rel.work_id='e76f31f2-eded-495e-9c5f-f03461c5cc3a'::uuid AND rel.release->>'reason'='staff_saved_director_application' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts rp WHERE rp.master_session_id=p_session AND rp.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id AND rp.request_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5('310493d3-92d2-4645-ba85-ab42f57dbf9d'::uuid,'mission-staff-unpublished-reinterpretation/1:ac9aedbd59dcb835d717f4ddb6ce195e3c2a9d640df576667290fa38b7e6cbbb') AND rp.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(rp.result) AND rp.result->'dispatch'=rel.request)) OR (rel.work_id='433ace05-5265-4aad-96a3-5567b6e3480a'::uuid AND rel.release->>'reason'='staff_unpublished_reinterpretation' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts original_successor WHERE original_successor.request_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(t.request_key,'mission-staff-no-dispatch-resume/1:'||t.source_revision) AND original_successor.master_session_id=p_session AND original_successor.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id AND original_successor.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(original_successor.result) AND original_successor.result->'dispatch'=rel.request)) OR (
    rel.work_id='e366b9fa-54dc-4abd-8ba6-9ceee83be9a4'::uuid AND rel.release->>'reason'='staff_saved_director_application'
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts retry_pr
     JOIN released origin ON origin.work_id='f4f7185e-4aae-4edd-ac24-65f8dcfa36f5'::uuid AND origin.source_revision=t.source_revision
     WHERE retry_pr.request_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(origin.work_id,'mission-staff-released-director-retry/1:'||t.source_revision)
      AND retry_pr.master_session_id=p_session AND retry_pr.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id
      AND retry_pr.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(retry_pr.result)
      AND pr.result->'dispatch'=origin.request AND retry_pr.result->'dispatch'=rel.request)))
 UNION ALL
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','request','request',cr.request),'request',cr.request,'work_id',cr.work_id,'receipt_id',cr.receipt_id,'result_sha256',cr.result_sha256,'release',cr.release) FROM combat_released cr
 ), carry_handoffs AS MATERIALIZED(
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','request','request',cp.request),
  'request',cp.request,'work_id',cp.work_id,'receipt_id',cp.receipt_id,'result_sha256',cp.result_sha256,
  'release',jsonb_build_object('source_window_id',cp.source_id,'source_revision',cp.source_revision,
   'reason',CASE WHEN cp.details->>'schema_version'='mission-director-count-overflow-release/1' THEN 'staff_director_count_overflow_reissued' ELSE 'staff_director_continuity_preprovider_reissued' END,'audit_sha256',public.combat_v2_sha256(cp.details),
   'successor_progress_key',cp.details->>'successor_progress_key','payload_sha256',cp.payload_sha256,
   'contract_sha256',cp.contract_sha256)) handoff
 FROM carry_parent_proofs cp WHERE cp.source_released IS TRUE
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM carry_published pub WHERE pub.work_id=cp.work_id)
 ORDER BY cp.work_id LIMIT 128
 ), bounded AS(SELECT DISTINCT item FROM items ORDER BY item LIMIT 128)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('schema_version',CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM carry_handoffs) THEN 'mission-journal-settlements/4' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM combat_released) THEN 'mission-journal-settlements/3' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM released) THEN 'mission-journal-settlements/2' ELSE 'mission-journal-settlements/1' END,'master_session_id',p_session,
  'items',coalesce(jsonb_agg(item ORDER BY item),'[]'::jsonb))
  || CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM carry_handoffs) THEN jsonb_build_object('handoffs',
   (SELECT jsonb_agg(handoff ORDER BY handoff) FROM carry_handoffs)) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END INTO result FROM bounded;
 writer46_items:=result->'items';
 -- A failed Count work remains failed. Its journal points to the actual successor publication only after the closed lineage is proven.
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','request','request',jsonb_build_object(
   'schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',old.master_session_id,'event_id',old.event_id,'request_key',old.request_key,'expected_revision',old.revision)),
  'request',jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',old.master_session_id,'event_id',old.event_id,'request_key',old.request_key,'expected_revision',old.revision),
  'work_id',old.id,'receipt_id',old.receipt_id,'result_sha256',old.result_sha256,
  'publication',jsonb_build_object('writer_work_id',child.id,'message_id',child.message_id,'receipt_id',child.receipt_id,'result_sha256',child.result_sha256))
 INTO writer46_item
 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a JOIN mission_generic_owner.work_items old ON old.dispatch_receipt_id=a.receipt_id
 JOIN LATERAL(SELECT mission_generic_owner.writer_count_reissue_proof_v1(old.id,NULL) proof) lp ON lp.proof->'published'='true'::jsonb
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.work_items child ON child.id=(lp.proof->>'successor_work_id')::uuid
 WHERE a.event_code='staff_writer_count_overflow_reissued_v1' AND old.master_session_id=p_session
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(writer46_items) i WHERE i->>'work_id'=old.id::text)
  AND jsonb_array_length(writer46_items)<128;
 IF writer46_item IS NOT NULL THEN result:=jsonb_set(result,'{items}',(result->'items')||jsonb_build_array(writer46_item));END IF;

 -- The original paid incomplete Director stays failed; journal closure follows only its actual successor publication.
 writer46_items:=result->'items';
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('selector',jsonb_build_object('kind','request','request',jsonb_build_object(
   'schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',old.master_session_id,'event_id',old.event_id,'request_key',old.request_key,'expected_revision',old.revision)),
  'request',jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',old.master_session_id,'event_id',old.event_id,'request_key',old.request_key,'expected_revision',old.revision),
  'work_id',old.id,'receipt_id',old.receipt_id,'result_sha256',old.result_sha256,'publication',lp.proof->'publication')
 INTO writer46_item
 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a JOIN mission_generic_owner.work_items old ON old.dispatch_receipt_id=a.receipt_id
 JOIN LATERAL(SELECT mission_generic_owner.director_incomplete_reissue_proof_v1(old.id,NULL) proof) lp ON lp.proof->'published'='true'::jsonb
 WHERE a.event_code='staff_director_incomplete_reissued_v1' AND old.master_session_id=p_session
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(writer46_items) i WHERE i->>'work_id'=old.id::text)
  AND jsonb_array_length(writer46_items)<128;
 IF writer46_item IS NOT NULL THEN result:=jsonb_set(result,'{items}',(result->'items')||jsonb_build_array(writer46_item));END IF;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.director_incomplete_reissue_proof_v1(p_work uuid, p_user uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
 rdw mission_generic_owner.work_items;
 rdwc mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1;
 rdd mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts;
 rdr mission_narrative_internal.provider_outputs_v1;
 rdu mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows;
 rdb mission_generic_owner.unified_batches;
 rdc mission_generic_owner.work_items;
 rdq jsonb;rdh jsonb;rdf jsonb;rdo jsonb;rdcount_start jsonb;rdcount_success jsonb;rdp jsonb;rda jsonb;rdrequest jsonb;rdpub boolean:=false;rdn integer;cfg jsonb;aud jsonb;prep jsonb;child mission_generic_owner.work_items;cs mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows;publication jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF p_work IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO rdw FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=p_work;
 IF rdw.id IS NULL OR rdw.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'director' OR rdw.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'failed'
  OR rdw.message_id IS NOT NULL OR rdw.result->'ok' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR rdw.result->>'provider_calls' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
  OR rdw.result->'outcome_uncertain' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR NOT coalesce(rdw.result->'failure_codes'='["MISSION_PROVIDER_INCOMPLETE"]'::jsonb,false)
  OR rdw.payload->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-director-work/4'
  OR rdw.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(rdw.payload)
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO rdwc FROM mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 WHERE work_id=rdw.id;
 IF rdwc.work_id IS NULL OR rdwc.master_session_id IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.master_session_id
  OR rdwc.contract_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(rdwc.contract)
  OR rdwc.contract->>'payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.payload_sha256
  OR rdwc.contract->>'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff_mission'
  OR NOT coalesce(rdwc.contract->'features' ? 'provider_output_retention_v1',false)
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO rdd FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts WHERE id=rdw.dispatch_receipt_id;
 rdrequest:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',rdw.master_session_id,
  'event_id',rdw.event_id,'request_key',rdw.request_key,'expected_revision',rdw.revision);
 IF rdd.id IS NULL OR rdd.master_session_id IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.master_session_id
  OR rdd.authority_receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.id OR rdd.request_key IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.request_key
  OR rdd.request_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM mission_internal.fingerprint(rdrequest)
  OR rdd.envelope_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(rdd.envelope)
  OR rdd.authority_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM rdd.envelope_sha256
  OR rdd.envelope->'narrative_admission' IS DISTINCT FROM rdwc.contract
  OR rdd.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'success' OR rdd.dispatch_count IS DISTINCT FROM 1
  OR rdd.finalized_at IS NULL
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations rdz
    WHERE rdz.id=rdw.authorization_id AND rdz.receipt_id=rdd.id)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls rdcall
    WHERE rdcall.source_id=rdd.id AND rdcall.producer='mission_generic_ai'
     AND rdcall.scope_id=rdw.master_session_id AND rdcall.call_no=1 AND rdcall.state='settled'
     AND rdcall.charged_usd=rdd.charged_cost_usd)
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT count(*),jsonb_agg(rdfinal.details)->0 INTO rdn,rdf
 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit rdfinal WHERE rdfinal.receipt_id=rdd.id AND rdfinal.event_code='generic_finalized';
 IF rdn<>1 OR rdf->>'work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.id::text
  OR rdf->>'receipt_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.receipt_id::text
  OR rdf->>'result_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.result_sha256
  OR rdf->>'result_jsonb_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(rdw.result)
  OR rdf->'stale' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR rdf->'outcome_uncertain' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR rdf->'command_receipt' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT count(*),jsonb_agg(rdowner.details)->0 INTO rdn,rdo
 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit rdowner WHERE rdowner.receipt_id=rdd.id AND rdowner.event_code='c1266_async_owner_v1';
 IF rdn<>1 OR NOT mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(rdo,ARRAY['schema_version','actor_user_id','work_id','request_sha256','envelope_sha256','provider_timeout_ms'])
  OR rdo->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-generic-async-owner/1'
  OR rdo->>'work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.id::text
  OR rdo->>'request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(rdrequest)
  OR rdo->>'envelope_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM rdd.envelope_sha256
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT count(*) INTO rdn FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_outputs_v1 rdout
 WHERE rdout.work_id=rdw.id AND rdout.authorization_id=rdw.authorization_id AND rdout.dispatch_id=rdw.dispatch_id;
 IF rdn<>1 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO rdr FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_outputs_v1 rdout
 WHERE rdout.work_id=rdw.id AND rdout.authorization_id=rdw.authorization_id AND rdout.dispatch_id=rdw.dispatch_id;
 IF rdr.dispatch_receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM rdd.id OR rdr.provider_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'incomplete'
  OR rdr.raw_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.result->>'raw_sha256'
  OR rdw.result->>'provider_status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'incomplete'
  OR rdr.raw_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(rdr.raw_output,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
  OR octet_length(rdr.raw_output) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 262144
  OR rdr.usage IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.result->'usage'
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT count(*),jsonb_agg(rdcount.details)->0 INTO rdn,rdcount_start
 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit rdcount WHERE rdcount.receipt_id=rdd.id AND rdcount.event_code='c8_count_started';
 IF rdn<>1 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT count(*),jsonb_agg(rdcount.details)->0 INTO rdn,rdcount_success
 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit rdcount WHERE rdcount.receipt_id=rdd.id AND rdcount.event_code='c8_count_success';
 IF rdn<>1 OR rdcount_start->>'work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.id::text
  OR rdcount_success->>'work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.id::text
  OR rdcount_start->>'measurement_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rdcount_success->>'measurement_id'
  OR rdcount_start->>'generation_request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.result->>'request_sha256'
  OR rdcount_start->>'generation_request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM rdcount_success->>'generation_request_sha256'
  OR rdcount_start->>'policy_snapshot_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(rdcount_start->'policy_snapshot')
  OR rdcount_success->>'policy_snapshot_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM rdcount_start->>'policy_snapshot_sha256'
  OR (rdcount_start->>'provider_input_contract_version' IN('mission-generic-provider-input/5','mission-generic-provider-input/6')) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
  OR rdcount_success->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'success' OR rdcount_success->'generation_allowed' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit rdunknown
    WHERE rdunknown.receipt_id=rdd.id AND rdunknown.event_code='c8_count_unknown')
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO rdu FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows WHERE id=rdw.authority_receipt_id AND work_id=rdw.id;
 IF rdu.id IS NULL OR rdu.master_session_id IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.master_session_id
  OR rdu.step_key IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.step_key OR rdu.run_control_version IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.run_control_version
  OR rdu.definition_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.definition_sha256 OR rdu.source_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.payload_sha256
  OR rdu.context IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.payload->'context' OR rdu.opportunities IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.payload->'opportunities'
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;

 IF rdw.result#>>'{provider_diagnostic,incomplete_reason}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'max_output_tokens'
 OR rdw.result#>'{provider_diagnostic,http_status}' IS DISTINCT FROM '200'::jsonb
 OR rdw.result#>'{usage,output_tokens}' IS DISTINCT FROM '20000'::jsonb
 OR rdw.result#>'{usage,reasoning_tokens}' IS DISTINCT FROM '11394'::jsonb
 -- provider.mjs persists JSON.stringify(response.output), not the response envelope.
 -- The immutable finalized result carries diagnostic status/reason; retained columns bind the same output and usage.
 OR jsonb_typeof(rdr.raw_output::jsonb) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR rdw.result#>>'{provider_diagnostic,schema_version}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-provider-diagnostic/1'
 OR rdw.result#>>'{provider_diagnostic,status}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'incomplete'
 OR rdw.result#>>'{provider_diagnostic,parse_state}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'NOT_ATTEMPTED'
 OR rdw.result#>>'{provider_diagnostic,usage_state}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'VALID'
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT count(*),jsonb_agg(a.details)->0 INTO rdn,prep FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a
 WHERE a.receipt_id=rdd.id AND a.event_code='staff_director_incomplete_prepared_v1';
 IF rdn>1 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF rdn=1 THEN
  IF prep->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-director-incomplete-prepared/1'
  OR prep->>'old_work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.id::text OR prep->>'old_result_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.result_sha256
  OR prep->>'old_result_jsonb_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(rdw.result)
  OR prep->>'old_payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.payload_sha256
  OR prep->>'owner_user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rdo->>'actor_user_id'
  OR prep->>'raw_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM rdr.raw_sha256 OR prep->>'raw_output_receipt_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rdr.id::text
  OR prep->>'source_window_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rdu.id::text OR prep->>'source_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM rdu.context->>'source_revision'
  OR prep->>'role_ids_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(rdu.role_ids))
  OR prep->>'source_before_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(rdu)-'superseded_at'-'superseded_reason')
  OR rdu.superseded_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff_failed_director_incomplete_retry' OR rdu.superseded_at IS NULL OR rdu.consumed_message_id IS NOT NULL
  THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
  SELECT count(*),jsonb_agg(a.details)->0 INTO rdn,aud FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a
   WHERE a.receipt_id=rdd.id AND a.event_code='staff_director_incomplete_reissued_v1';
  IF rdn>1 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
  IF rdn=1 THEN
   SELECT * INTO child FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=(prep->>'successor_work_id')::uuid;
   SELECT * INTO cs FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows WHERE id=child.authority_receipt_id AND work_id=child.id;
   IF child.id IS NULL OR child.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'director' OR child.master_session_id IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.master_session_id
   OR child.step_key IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.step_key OR child.run_control_version IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.run_control_version
   OR child.definition_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.definition_sha256 OR child.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(child.payload)
   OR cs.role_ids IS DISTINCT FROM rdu.role_ids OR cs.context->>'source_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM rdu.context->>'source_revision'

'fati_counts',(SELECT jsonb_object_agg(label,n)FROM(SELECT sc.label,count(DISTINCT m.id)n FROM scope sc LEFT JOIN mission_generic_owner.work_items w ON w.master_session_id=sc.sid AND w.message_id IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN public.messages m ON m.id=w.message_id AND m.kind='fato' GROUP BY sc.label)t),

# Writer Count recovery46 · contratto congelato

## Percorso

Normale pulsante server-event recovery → Edge Auth → `event_claim` verifica pureproof nuova → `event_next` chiama helper reissue privato → prima riconcilia Count con count_overflow_terminal esistente, poi crea un solo successor Writer append-only → aggiorna il puntatore tecnico batch → normale dispatch_claim mode `normal` → nuovo Count della richiesta compact lossless → Generation/Writer normale → unico Fato tramite publisher esistente.

Nessun nuovo native_claim mode HTTP, RPC pubblica o valore client. Gli eventi writer_ready generati dal trigger puntano allo stesso successor e non danno una seconda lease/Gen: work/event/request IDs idempotenti e normale claim restano autorevoli.

## Conservazione

Vecchio Count fallito diventa terminale autorevolmente solo se ancora claimed con Count overflow dimostrato, e conserva ticket/costo. Una volta finalizzato non si modifica più result, receipt, payload o SHA. Director completato, output JSON originale, SHA registrata e SHA JSONB, decisione server, source window e role IDs restano identici. Nessuna azione reinviata, nuovo Director o vecchio Fato modificato.

La pureproof confronta vecchio audit Count+ledger, parent completed e audit finalize (storedSHA può differire dal JSONB); `c1266_role_work_attest_v2` riusa l’attestazione corrente del Writer puntato per legare parent, coorte e decisione tipizzata. Il nuovo Writer ha payload IDENTICO; soltanto event/request/dedupe/work IDs cambiano deterministicamente.

## Lineage persistente e chiusura

Prima di spostare il puntatore batch, dispatch_audit append-only conserva count_terminal_proof completo+hash, vecchio work/result/payload/dispatchhash, Count tickethash, decisione+Director resultSHA e JSONBhash, sourceWindow+roleIDs, owner e successor UUIDs. L’audit è immutabile per trigger già attivo e ACL postgres-only.

`writer_count_reissue_proof_v1(old,NULL)` legge SOLO lineage storico se audit esiste; senza audit ritorna NULL prima di richiamare Countproof, evitando ricorsione. Il Countproof finalized aggiornato dall’altro owner può restituire il Countproof conservato dopo verifica della lineage anche se batch punta al successor o è già pubblicato.

Il journal conserva il vecchio work come failed. SOLO DOPO publication attestata del successor aggiunge un item con old request/receipt/resultSHA e la publication del child reale: shape già ammessa dal client e dal controllo Stafffinish, senza inventare una publication del vecchio work. Finché child non pubblicato il journal non dichiara quel completamento.

## Permessi e attivazione

Due helper nello schema privato, owner postgres, SECURITY DEFINER search_path vuoto, EXECUTE revocato a PUBLIC/anon/authenticated/service_role. Chiamata mutante protetta da service_only, normale dispatch_user, Staff e source freeze, mutex, locks e CAS. La policy Root consente una sola successione per l’esatto old work/payload B.

Stage separato inerte: crea solo helper chiusi mentre manca la policy e nessun consumer li chiama. Dopo readback OIDs/header si compone il materiale finale con Root, policy, Countproof tipizzato/lineage, event claim/next, journal e Edge compact. Nessun apply eseguito dall’autore.

## Limiti di prova

Sei SQL readonly di diagnosi/catalogo/provenance; zero provider o gameplay. Non sono stati eseguiti DB locali, fixture o chiamate mutanti. Review indipendente aggregata e materiale sono ancora richieste. Nessuna qualifica runtime/editoriale; tutte le precedenti correzioni e contatori restano cumulativi.

  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts da WHERE da.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id)

   AND NOT(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a WHERE a.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND a.event_code='c8_count_success'
     AND a.details->'generation_allowed'='true'::jsonb AND a.details->'generation_http_calls'='0'::jsonb)
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a WHERE a.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND a.event_code='c8_count_unknown')))) THEN
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-event-claim/1','event_key',e.event_key,'event_version',e.event_version,'status','busy');END IF;
 END IF;
 IF NOT terminal_reconcile AND e.state='running' AND e.claim_expires_at>clock_timestamp() THEN RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-event-claim/1',
 'event_key',e.event_key,'event_version',e.event_version,'status','busy');END IF;
 END IF;
 SELECT rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>'{config,c1266_server_events}' INTO cfg
 FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness rr
 WHERE rr.singleton AND rr.state='enabled' AND rr.scope='staff'
 AND rr.revision_sha256=rr.observed_revision_sha256;
 IF cfg->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'c1266-server-events/1'
 OR cfg->'enabled' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'EVENT42_MODE_DISABLED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions m JOIN public.locations l ON l.id=m.location_id
 WHERE m.id=e.master_session_id AND m.owner_kind='ai_service' AND m.master_user IS NULL
 AND m.closed_at IS NULL AND m.suspended_at IS NULL AND m.stato IN('preparazione','in_corso')
 AND l.id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid AND l.is_test AND l.is_active)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id=e.root_principal AND p.role IN('admin','master'))
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.start_claims sc
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.board_starts bs ON bs.request_key=sc.request_key
 WHERE sc.request_key=e.root_request_key AND sc.actor_user_id=e.root_principal
 AND sc.session_id=e.master_session_id AND bs.master_session_id=e.master_session_id
 AND public.combat_v2_sha256(bs.result)=e.root_receipt_sha256)
 OR mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_scope_v1(e.master_session_id) IS NULL
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'EVENT42_SCOPE_REJECTED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;

 -- Trusted explicit recovery can acknowledge a proved already-finalized work. No lease,
 -- authorization, Count, Generation, progress or publication is created by this branch.
 IF recover AND terminal_reconcile THEN
  IF e.claim_id IS NULL OR e.canonical_request IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(
   'schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',w.master_session_id,
   'event_id',w.event_id,'request_key',w.request_key,'expected_revision',w.revision)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'EVENT42_WORK_DRIFT' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
  IF e.state='terminal' AND e.settle_result->>'state'='terminal' THEN
   RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-event-claim/1','event_key',e.event_key,'event_version',e.event_version,'status','terminal');END IF;
  UPDATE mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1 SET state='terminal',claim_history=claim_history||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('claim_id',claim_id,'expires_at',claim_expires_at,'state',state,'recovery_request_key',recovery_request_key,'settle_result',settle_result,'next_result_sha256',CASE WHEN next_result IS NOT NULL THEN public.combat_v2_sha256(next_result) ELSE NULL END)),
   recovery_request_key=request_key,settle_result=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-event-settle/1',
    'event_key',event_key,'event_version',event_version,'claim_id',claim_id,'master_session_id',master_session_id,'state','terminal'),
   updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE event_key=e.event_key AND event_version=e.event_version;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-event-claim/1','event_key',e.event_key,'event_version',e.event_version,'status','terminal');
 END IF;

 UPDATE mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1 SET state='running',claim_history=claim_history||CASE WHEN claim_id IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('claim_id',claim_id,'expires_at',claim_expires_at,'state',state,'recovery_request_key',recovery_request_key,'settle_result',settle_result,'next_result_sha256',CASE WHEN next_result IS NOT NULL THEN public.combat_v2_sha256(next_result) ELSE NULL END)) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,recovery_request_key=CASE WHEN recover THEN request_key ELSE NULL END,settle_result=NULL,next_result=CASE WHEN recover THEN NULL ELSE next_result END,claim_id=pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid(),
 claimed_at=clock_timestamp(),claim_expires_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '400 seconds',updated_at=clock_timestamp()
 WHERE event_key=e.event_key AND event_version=e.event_version RETURNING * INTO e;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-event-claim/1','event_key',e.event_key,'event_version',e.event_version,
 'status','claimed','claim_id',e.claim_id,'master_session_id',e.master_session_id,'principal_user',e.root_principal,
 'mode','staff_simulation','scope_location','0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b','expires_at',e.claim_expires_at);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mission_generic_event_next_v1(p_event_key uuid, p_event_version bigint, p_claim_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
 SET statement_timeout TO '20s'
AS $function$
DECLARE e mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1;cfg jsonb;progress jsonb;candidate jsonb;flow jsonb;writer46 jsonb;
 event43_observed_work uuid:=NULL;event43_observed_request jsonb:=NULL;
 w mission_generic_owner.work_items;req uuid;outcome text;native_claim jsonb;role_source_user uuid;native_mode text;paid_action boolean:=false;
BEGIN
 PERFORM mission_ai_board_owner.service_only();
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock_shared(hashtextextended('C1266:GENERIC-AI:AVAILABILITY',0));
 SELECT * INTO e FROM mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1 WHERE event_key=p_event_key AND event_version=p_event_version FOR UPDATE;
 IF NOT FOUND OR e.claim_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_claim_id OR p_claim_id IS NULL OR e.claimed_at IS NULL
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'EVENT42_CLAIM_REJECTED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF e.next_result IS NOT NULL THEN RETURN jsonb_set(jsonb_set(jsonb_set(e.next_result,'{state}','"uncertain"'::jsonb),'{request}','null'::jsonb),'{native_claim}','null'::jsonb); END IF;
 IF e.state<>'running' OR e.claim_expires_at<=clock_timestamp() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'EVENT42_CLAIM_EXPIRED' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 SELECT rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>'{config,c1266_server_events}' INTO cfg
 FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness rr
 WHERE rr.singleton AND rr.state='enabled' AND rr.scope='staff'
 AND rr.revision_sha256=rr.observed_revision_sha256;
 IF cfg->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'c1266-server-events/1'
 OR cfg->'enabled' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'EVENT42_MODE_DISABLED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions m JOIN public.locations l ON l.id=m.location_id
 WHERE m.id=e.master_session_id AND m.owner_kind='ai_service' AND m.master_user IS NULL
 AND m.closed_at IS NULL AND m.suspended_at IS NULL AND m.stato IN('preparazione','in_corso')
 AND l.id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid AND l.is_test AND l.is_active)
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id=e.root_principal AND p.role IN('admin','master'))
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.start_claims sc
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.board_starts bs ON bs.request_key=sc.request_key
 WHERE sc.request_key=e.root_request_key AND sc.actor_user_id=e.root_principal
 AND sc.session_id=e.master_session_id AND bs.master_session_id=e.master_session_id
 AND public.combat_v2_sha256(bs.result)=e.root_receipt_sha256)
 OR mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_scope_v1(e.master_session_id) IS NULL
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'EVENT42_SCOPE_REJECTED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;

 PERFORM 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors WHERE master_session_id=e.master_session_id FOR UPDATE;
 PERFORM public.master_v2_lock_scope(e.master_session_id);
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.mission_run_state r WHERE r.master_session_id=e.master_session_id AND r.run_phase NOT IN('preparazione','in_corso'))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b WHERE b.master_session_id=e.master_session_id AND b.state='needs_review') THEN
 outcome:='waiting';
 ELSE
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1 newer WHERE newer.event_key=e.event_key AND newer.event_version>e.event_version) THEN outcome:='waiting';END IF;
 IF e.event_domain='role_window' THEN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_submissions c JOIN mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors rc
 ON rc.master_session_id=c.master_session_id AND rc.window_epoch=c.window_epoch
 WHERE c.master_session_id=e.master_session_id AND c.message_id=e.source_id
 AND public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(c))=e.source_sha256) THEN outcome:='waiting';END IF;
 SELECT user_id INTO role_source_user FROM mission_generic_owner.role_submissions WHERE master_session_id=e.master_session_id AND message_id=e.source_id;
 IF e.work_id IS NULL THEN flow:=mission_generic_owner.role_flow_status_v1(e.master_session_id,role_source_user); ELSE flow:=jsonb_build_object('flow_reason','ready_to_evaluate');END IF;
 IF flow->>'flow_reason' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ready_to_evaluate' THEN outcome:='waiting';END IF;
 END IF;
 IF e.event_domain='phase' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.mission_run_state fresh
 WHERE fresh.master_session_id=e.master_session_id AND fresh.control_version=e.event_version
 AND public.combat_v2_sha256(jsonb_build_object('step',fresh.current_step_key,'control',fresh.control_version,'plan',fresh.plan_sha256))=e.source_sha256) THEN outcome:='waiting';END IF;
 IF outcome IS NULL THEN
 req:=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(e.event_key,'server-event/1:'||e.event_version::text);
 -- Existing producer owns every wait/choice/report/transition rule. No client booleans.
 IF e.work_id IS NOT NULL AND e.canonical_request IS NOT NULL THEN
 candidate:=e.canonical_request;
 ELSE
 candidate:=public.mission_generic_dispatch_next_v1(e.master_session_id,e.root_principal)->'request';
 IF candidate IS NULL OR candidate='null'::jsonb THEN
 candidate:=NULL;progress:=mission_generic_owner.progress_step(e.master_session_id,e.root_principal,req);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 IF candidate IS NULL THEN candidate:=progress->'dispatch';END IF;
 IF candidate IS NULL OR candidate='null'::jsonb THEN
 candidate:=public.mission_generic_dispatch_next_v1(e.master_session_id,e.root_principal)->'request';
 END IF;
 IF candidate IS NOT NULL AND candidate<>'null'::jsonb THEN
 IF NOT mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(candidate,ARRAY['schema_version','master_session_id','event_id','request_key','expected_revision'])
 OR candidate->>'schema_version'<>'mission-generic-request/1' OR candidate->>'master_session_id'<>e.master_session_id::text THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'EVENT42_REQUEST_REJECTED' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT w FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE master_session_id=e.master_session_id
 AND event_id=(candidate->>'event_id')::uuid AND request_key=(candidate->>'request_key')::uuid
 AND revision=(candidate->>'expected_revision')::integer;
 IF e.recovery_request_key IS NOT NULL AND mission_generic_owner.writer_count_reissue_proof_v1(w.id,e.root_principal) IS NOT NULL THEN
 writer46:=mission_generic_owner.writer_count_reissue_v1(w.id,e.root_principal);candidate:=writer46->'request';
 IF writer46->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-writer-count-reissue-result/1'
 OR NOT mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(candidate,ARRAY['schema_version','master_session_id','event_id','request_key','expected_revision'])
 OR candidate->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-generic-request/1' OR candidate->>'master_session_id' IS DISTINCT FROM e.master_session_id::text
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'EVENT46_WRITER_REISSUE_REJECTED' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT w FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=(writer46->>'successor_work_id')::uuid
  AND master_session_id=e.master_session_id AND event_id=(candidate->>'event_id')::uuid
  AND request_key=(candidate->>'request_key')::uuid AND revision=(candidate->>'expected_revision')::bigint;
 -- The existing event authorization fence is updated before the ordinary dispatcher owns the new claim.
 UPDATE mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1 SET claim_txid=txid_current(),claim_backend=pg_backend_pid(),
  work_id=w.id,canonical_request=candidate WHERE event_key=e.event_key AND event_version=e.event_version;
 native_claim:=public.mission_generic_dispatch_claim_v1(e.root_principal,candidate);native_mode:='normal';
 ELSIF e.recovery_request_key IS NOT NULL AND w.state='failed' AND w.kind='director'
 AND(mission_generic_owner.retained_director_adoption_v1(w.id,false)->>'owner_user_id'=e.root_principal::text) IS TRUE THEN
 native_claim:=jsonb_build_object('mode','retained_director','body',jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-retained-director-recovery/1',
 'mode','prepare','master_session_id',w.master_session_id,'work_id',w.id));outcome:='dispatch';paid_action:=true;
 ELSIF e.recovery_request_key IS NOT NULL AND w.state='failed' AND w.kind='narration'
 AND w.result->'ok'='true'::jsonb AND w.result->>'provider_calls'='1' AND w.result->'outcome_uncertain'='false'::jsonb
 AND (w.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.result) OR EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit hp_finalized
 WHERE hp_finalized.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND hp_finalized.event_code='generic_finalized'
 AND hp_finalized.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text
 AND hp_finalized.details->>'receipt_id'=w.receipt_id::text
 AND hp_finalized.details->>'state'=w.state
 AND hp_finalized.details->'message_id' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM coalesce(to_jsonb(w.message_id),'null'::jsonb)
 AND hp_finalized.details->>'result_sha256'=w.result_sha256
 AND hp_finalized.details->>'result_jsonb_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.result))) THEN
 native_claim:=jsonb_build_object('mode','cached_publication','body',jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-staff-cached-publication/1',
 'master_session_id',w.master_session_id,'work_id',w.id));outcome:='dispatch';paid_action:=true;
 ELSIF e.recovery_request_key IS NOT NULL AND w.state='claimed' AND w.lease_expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a WHERE a.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND a.event_code='c8_count_success'
  AND a.details->'generation_allowed'='true'::jsonb AND a.details->'generation_http_calls'='0'::jsonb)
 AND w.authorization_id IS NULL AND w.dispatch_id IS NULL AND w.result IS NULL
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts da WHERE da.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations pa WHERE pa.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a WHERE a.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND a.event_code='c8_count_unknown') THEN
 -- Existing RPC owns all Count/source/request/prices/ticket/current-authority checks and grants the real replacement lease.
 native_claim:=public.mission_generic_counted_resume_v1(e.root_principal,candidate);native_mode:='counted_resume';
 ELSIF(w.state='ready' AND w.lease_id IS NULL OR w.state='claimed' AND w.lease_expires_at<=clock_timestamp())
 AND w.authorization_id IS NULL AND w.dispatch_id IS NULL AND w.result IS NULL AND w.receipt_id IS NULL
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a WHERE a.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND a.event_code='c8_count_started')
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations pa WHERE pa.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_attempts da WHERE da.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id) THEN
 UPDATE mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1 SET claim_txid=txid_current(),claim_backend=pg_backend_pid(),
 work_id=w.id,canonical_request=candidate WHERE event_key=e.event_key AND event_version=e.event_version;
 native_claim:=public.mission_generic_dispatch_claim_v1(e.root_principal,candidate);native_mode:='normal';
 ELSE
  -- Observe existing in-flight work only; no lease, claim, dispatch or replay is granted.
  IF e.event_domain='native_input' AND e.work_id IS NULL AND e.canonical_request IS NULL
   AND w.kind='narration' AND w.state IN('claimed','authorized','provider_started')
   AND candidate=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1',
   'master_session_id',w.master_session_id,'event_id',w.event_id,
   'request_key',w.request_key,'expected_revision',w.revision)
   AND EXISTS(
   WITH event43_sources AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT src.round_id,src.declaration_id,src.coverage_id,src.source_kind
 FROM (
 SELECT dc.round_id,dc.defense_declaration_id AS declaration_id,dc.id AS coverage_id,'coverage'::text AS source_kind
 FROM public.combat_v2_defense_coverages dc
 JOIN public.combat_v2_declarations dd ON dd.id=dc.defense_declaration_id AND dd.round_id=dc.round_id
 JOIN public.combat_v2_actors aa ON aa.id=dd.actor_id AND aa.actor_kind='pg'
 WHERE dc.id=e.source_id AND e.source_sha256 IN(
 public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(dc)),
 public.combat_v2_sha256(jsonb_set(to_jsonb(dc),'{state}','"dichiarata"'::jsonb)))
 UNION ALL
 SELECT rt.round_id,rt.declaration_id,NULL::uuid,'rating'::text
 FROM public.combat_v2_ratings rt
 JOIN public.combat_v2_declarations dd ON dd.id=rt.declaration_id AND dd.round_id=rt.round_id
 WHERE rt.id=e.source_id AND rt.is_active
 AND e.source_sha256 IN(public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(rt)),
 public.combat_v2_sha256(jsonb_set(to_jsonb(rt),'{frozen_at}','null'::jsonb)))
 UNION ALL
 SELECT dd.round_id,dd.id,NULL::uuid,'declaration'::text
 FROM public.combat_v2_declarations dd JOIN public.combat_v2_actors aa ON aa.id=dd.actor_id AND aa.actor_kind='pg'
 WHERE dd.id=e.source_id AND e.source_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(dd))
 ) src)
   SELECT 1 FROM event43_sources event43_src
   JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds event43_round ON event43_round.id=event43_src.round_id
   JOIN public.combat_v2_sessions event43_enc ON event43_enc.id=event43_round.session_id
    AND event43_enc.master_session_id=e.master_session_id
   JOIN public.master_v2_sessions event43_master ON event43_master.id=e.master_session_id
    AND event43_master.location_id=event43_enc.location_id
   JOIN mission_generic_owner.work_items event43_observed
    ON event43_observed.id=w.id AND event43_observed.master_session_id=e.master_session_id
    AND event43_observed.kind='narration' AND event43_observed.state IN('claimed','authorized','provider_started')
    AND event43_observed.event_id=w.event_id AND event43_observed.request_key=w.request_key
    AND event43_observed.revision=w.revision AND event43_observed.authority_receipt_id=w.authority_receipt_id
    AND event43_observed.encounter_id=event43_enc.id
   JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches event43_batch
    ON event43_batch.master_session_id=e.master_session_id AND event43_batch.encounter_id=event43_enc.id
    AND event43_batch.source_round_id=event43_round.id
    AND event43_batch.source_report_id=event43_round.report_id
   WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM event43_sources)=1
   AND e.event_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(event43_round.id,'server-event:native-input')
   AND e.created_at<=event43_batch.created_at
   AND event43_batch.id=w.event_id AND event43_batch.id=w.authority_receipt_id
   AND event43_batch.writer_work_id=w.id AND event43_batch.encounter_id=w.encounter_id
   AND event43_batch.state IN('preparing','ready') AND event43_batch.retired_at IS NULL
   AND event43_batch.message_id IS NULL
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches event43_other
    WHERE event43_other.master_session_id=e.master_session_id
    AND event43_other.source_round_id=event43_round.id AND event43_other.id<>event43_batch.id
    AND event43_other.retired_at IS NULL AND event43_other.state IN('preparing','ready','published'))
   ) THEN event43_observed_work:=w.id;event43_observed_request:=candidate;END IF;
  outcome:='uncertain';candidate:=NULL;
 END IF;
 IF NOT paid_action AND native_mode IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF native_claim->>'state'='claimed' AND native_claim->'granted_now'='true'::jsonb THEN
 native_claim:=jsonb_build_object('mode',native_mode,'body',native_claim);outcome:='dispatch';
 ELSE outcome:='uncertain';candidate:=NULL;native_claim:=NULL;END IF;
 END IF;
 ELSE outcome:='waiting';candidate:=NULL; END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 progress:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-event-next/1','event_key',e.event_key,'event_version',e.event_version,
 'claim_id',e.claim_id,'master_session_id',e.master_session_id,'state',outcome,'request',candidate,'native_claim',native_claim);
 UPDATE mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1 SET next_result=jsonb_set(progress,'{native_claim}','null'::jsonb),native_claim_sha256=CASE WHEN native_claim IS NOT NULL THEN public.combat_v2_sha256(native_claim) ELSE native_claim_sha256 END,
 work_id=CASE WHEN outcome='dispatch' THEN w.id
 WHEN event43_observed_work IS NOT NULL AND work_id IS NULL AND canonical_request IS NULL THEN event43_observed_work ELSE work_id END,
 canonical_request=CASE WHEN outcome='dispatch' THEN candidate
 WHEN event43_observed_work IS NOT NULL AND work_id IS NULL AND canonical_request IS NULL THEN event43_observed_request ELSE canonical_request END,updated_at=clock_timestamp()
 WHERE event_key=e.event_key AND event_version=e.event_version;
 RETURN progress;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.staff_journal_settlements_v1(p_session uuid, p_user uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb;verified_manual jsonb;manual_count_none boolean;writer46_item jsonb;writer46_items jsonb;
BEGIN
 -- This private reader is called only from the already authenticated room projection.
 -- Settled collective publications are readable by each current Staff participant;
 -- they confer no owner, retry, claim, tick, provider or gameplay authority.
 IF p_session IS NULL OR p_user IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions s JOIN public.locations l ON l.id=s.location_id
  JOIN public.master_v2_participants mp ON mp.session_id=s.id AND mp.user_id_snapshot=p_user
   AND mp.left_at IS NULL AND mp.engagement_state='attivo'
  JOIN public.characters ch ON ch.id=mp.character_id AND ch.user_id=mp.user_id_snapshot
  JOIN public.profiles pr ON pr.id=p_user AND pr.role IN('admin','master')
  WHERE s.id=p_session AND s.owner_kind='ai_service' AND s.master_user IS NULL
   AND s.location_id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid
   AND l.is_active AND l.is_test AND s.closed_at IS NULL AND s.suspended_at IS NULL
   AND s.stato='in_corso')
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;

      ON native_narrative.round_id=native_round.id AND native_narrative.report_id=native_report.id

      AND native_narrative.body=msg.body AND native_narrative.author_user IS NULL
    WHERE w.payload->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-narration/3'
      AND w.payload->>'mode'='unified' AND w.payload->'source_windows'='[]'::jsonb
      AND native_batch.id=w.authority_receipt_id AND native_batch.master_session_id=p_session
      AND native_batch.writer_work_id=w.id AND native_batch.retired_at IS NULL
      AND native_batch.state='published' AND native_batch.published_at IS NOT NULL
      AND native_batch.message_id=w.message_id AND native_batch.source_window_id IS NULL
      AND native_batch.decision_work_id IS NULL AND native_batch.decision IS NULL
      AND native_batch.encounter_id=w.encounter_id AND native_batch.step_key=w.step_key
      AND native_batch.run_control_version=w.run_control_version
      AND native_batch.payload=w.payload AND native_batch.payload_sha256=w.payload_sha256
      AND native_batch.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(native_batch.payload)
      AND w.payload->>'batch_id'=native_batch.id::text
      AND w.payload->>'composition_kind'=native_batch.composition_kind
      AND native_round.state='narrato' AND native_round.phase='narrato' AND native_round.narrated_at IS NOT NULL
      AND native_report.narration_state='pubblicata' AND native_report.narrator_kind='ia'
      AND native_report.narrated_at IS NOT NULL AND native_report.message_id=w.message_id
      AND native_report.values_written IS FALSE
      AND native_report.mechanics_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(native_report.mechanics)
      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.payload->'resolved_scenes') native_scene
        WHERE native_scene#>>'{scene_binding,round_id}'=native_round.id::text
          AND native_scene#>>'{scene_binding,session_id}'=native_batch.encounter_id::text
          AND native_scene#>>'{scene_binding,report_sha256}'=native_report.mechanics_sha256
          AND native_scene#>'{barrier,required_receipt_ids}' @> jsonb_build_array(native_report.id))
      AND w.payload#>>'{publication_barrier,closed}'='true'
      AND w.payload#>'{publication_barrier,receipt_ids}'=w.payload#>'{publication_barrier,required_receipt_ids}'

      AND (native_batch.secondary_report_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(
        SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_round_reports secondary_report

          AND secondary_round.session_id=native_batch.encounter_id
        JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_report_publications secondary_publication

          AND secondary_publication.batch_id=native_batch.id AND NOT secondary_publication.primary_report
          AND secondary_publication.message_id=w.message_id
        WHERE secondary_report.id=native_batch.secondary_report_id
          AND secondary_report.narration_state='pubblicata' AND secondary_report.message_id IS NULL
          AND secondary_report.values_written IS FALSE
          AND secondary_report.mechanics_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(secondary_report.mechanics)))
   )
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.board_starts bs
    JOIN public.mission_run_publications pub ON pub.master_session_id=bs.master_session_id AND pub.event_id=bs.event_id
    JOIN public.mission_run_outbox ob ON ob.publication_id=pub.id AND ob.master_session_id=p_session AND ob.event_id=bs.event_id
     AND ob.state='published' AND ob.published_at IS NOT NULL
    WHERE bs.master_session_id=p_session AND bs.id=w.event_id AND bs.id=w.authority_receipt_id
     AND bs.id::text=w.payload->>'opening_start_receipt_id' AND bs.state='published' AND bs.published_at IS NOT NULL
     AND bs.result->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text AND bs.result->>'event_id'=bs.event_id::text
     AND bs.result->>'start_receipt_id'=bs.id::text
     AND pub.context_fingerprint=bs.result->>'context_fingerprint' AND ob.context_fingerprint=pub.context_fingerprint
     AND pub.status='committed'
     AND pub.body_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(msg.body,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')))
 ), carry_published AS MATERIALIZED(
 SELECT parent.request,parent.work_id,parent.receipt_id,parent.result_sha256,parent.source_revision,
  jsonb_build_object('writer_work_id',pub.writer_work_id,'message_id',pub.message_id,
   'receipt_id',pub.receipt_id,'result_sha256',pub.result_sha256) publication
 FROM carry_parent_proofs parent
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts successor_progress
  ON successor_progress.master_session_id=p_session
   AND successor_progress.request_key::text=parent.details->>'successor_progress_key'
   AND successor_progress.actor_user_id::text=parent.details->>'actor_user_id'
   AND successor_progress.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(successor_progress.result)
   AND successor_progress.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-progress/1'
   AND successor_progress.result->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text
 JOIN qualified child ON child.kind='director' AND child.state='completed'
  AND child.request=successor_progress.result->'dispatch'
 JOIN mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 child_contract ON child_contract.work_id=child.id
  AND child_contract.master_session_id=p_session AND child_contract.definition_sha256=child.definition_sha256
  AND child_contract.payload_sha256=child.payload_sha256
  AND child_contract.contract_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(child_contract.contract)
  AND (child_contract.release_sha256=parent.details->>'fixed_release_sha256'
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit cp25_witness
    JOIN mission_generic_owner.work_items cp25_parent ON cp25_parent.id=parent.work_id
     AND cp25_parent.dispatch_receipt_id=cp25_witness.receipt_id
    WHERE cp25_witness.event_code='staff_director_continuity_release_compatible'
     AND mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(cp25_witness.details,ARRAY['schema_version','parent_work_id','parent_receipt_id','parent_dispatch_receipt_id','parent_result_sha256','parent_payload_sha256','parent_contract_sha256','source_window_id','source_revision','role_ids_sha256','definition_sha256','step_key','run_control_version','parent_release_audit_sha256','successor_progress_key','historical_actor_user_id','from_root_sha256','to_root_sha256','protected_invariants_sha256','recipe_sha256','source_review_sha256','deployment_kind','witness_sha256'])
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'schema_version'='mission-continuity-parent-root-transition/1'
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'deployment_kind'='reviewed_atomic_root_installation'
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'witness_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(cp25_witness.details-'witness_sha256')
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'parent_work_id'=parent.work_id::text
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'parent_receipt_id'=parent.receipt_id::text
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'parent_dispatch_receipt_id'=cp25_parent.dispatch_receipt_id::text
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'parent_result_sha256'=parent.result_sha256
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'parent_payload_sha256'=parent.payload_sha256
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'parent_contract_sha256'=parent.contract_sha256
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'source_window_id'=parent.source_id::text
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'source_revision'=parent.source_revision
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'role_ids_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(parent.role_ids))
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'definition_sha256'=parent.parent_definition_sha256
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'step_key'=parent.parent_step_key
     AND cp25_witness.details->'run_control_version'=to_jsonb(parent.parent_control_version)
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'parent_release_audit_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(parent.details)
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'successor_progress_key'=parent.details->>'successor_progress_key'
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'historical_actor_user_id'=parent.details->>'actor_user_id'
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'from_root_sha256'=parent.details->>'fixed_release_sha256'
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'to_root_sha256'=child_contract.release_sha256
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'to_root_sha256'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'protected_invariants_sha256'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'recipe_sha256'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
     AND cp25_witness.details->>'source_review_sha256'~'^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
     AND child.created_at>=cp25_witness.created_at
     AND (child_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,work_id}',child_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,master_session_id}',child_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,definition_sha256}',child_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,payload_sha256}',child_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,release_sha256}',child_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,authority_receipt_id}')
      IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (child.id::text,p_session::text,child.definition_sha256,child.payload_sha256,child_contract.release_sha256,child.authority_receipt_id::text)
     AND child_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,schema_version}'='c1266-work-execution-attestation/3'
     AND child_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,execution_context}'='staff_mission'
     AND child_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,release_sha256}'=child_contract.release_sha256
     AND child_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,binding_sha256}'=child.definition_sha256
     AND child_contract.contract#>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,admission}'=parent.parent_admission
     AND child_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,financial_qualification_sha256}'=parent.parent_financial_sha256
     AND child_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,c7_budget_qualification_sha256}'=parent.parent_c7_sha256
     AND child_contract.contract#>>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,source_qualification_sha256}'=public.combat_v2_sha256(child_contract.contract#>'{source_attestation,execution_authority,source_qualification}')
   ))
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows child_source ON child_source.id=child.authority_receipt_id
  AND child_source.work_id=child.id AND child_source.master_session_id=p_session
  AND child_source.role_ids=parent.role_ids AND child_source.context->>'source_revision'=parent.source_revision
  AND child_source.source_sha256=child.payload_sha256 AND child_source.definition_sha256=child.definition_sha256
  AND child_source.step_key=parent.parent_step_key AND child_source.run_control_version=parent.parent_control_version
  AND child_source.definition_sha256=parent.parent_definition_sha256
  AND child_source.superseded_at IS NULL AND child_source.consumed_message_id IS NOT NULL
 JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches child_batch ON child_batch.source_window_id=child_source.id
  AND child_batch.decision_work_id=child.id AND child_batch.master_session_id=p_session
  AND child_batch.state='published' AND child_batch.published_at IS NOT NULL AND child_batch.retired_at IS NULL
  AND child_batch.message_id=child_source.consumed_message_id
 JOIN published pub ON pub.writer_work_id=child_batch.writer_work_id AND pub.message_id=child_batch.message_id
 WHERE parent.source_released IS TRUE
 ), settled_raw AS MATERIALIZED(
  SELECT w.request,w.id AS work_id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,
   jsonb_build_object('writer_work_id',p.writer_work_id,'message_id',p.message_id,'receipt_id',p.receipt_id,'result_sha256',p.result_sha256) AS publication
  FROM qualified w JOIN published p ON p.writer_work_id=w.id WHERE w.kind='narration'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w.request,w.id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,
   jsonb_build_object('writer_work_id',p.writer_work_id,'message_id',p.message_id,'receipt_id',p.receipt_id,'result_sha256',p.result_sha256)
  FROM qualified w
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw ON sw.work_id=w.id AND sw.id=w.authority_receipt_id
   AND sw.master_session_id=p_session AND sw.consumed_message_id IS NOT NULL AND sw.superseded_at IS NULL
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub ON ub.source_window_id=sw.id AND ub.decision_work_id=w.id
   AND ub.master_session_id=p_session AND ub.state='published' AND ub.published_at IS NOT NULL
   AND ub.message_id=sw.consumed_message_id
  JOIN published p ON p.writer_work_id=ub.writer_work_id AND p.message_id=sw.consumed_message_id
  WHERE w.kind='director'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w.request,w.id,w.receipt_id,w.result_sha256,
   jsonb_build_object('writer_work_id',p.writer_work_id,'message_id',p.message_id,'receipt_id',p.receipt_id,'result_sha256',p.result_sha256)
  FROM qualified w
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.panel_choices pc ON pc.work_id=w.id AND pc.id=(w.payload->>'capability_id')::uuid
   AND pc.master_session_id=p_session AND pc.encounter_id=w.encounter_id
   AND pc.actor_id=(w.payload->>'actor_id')::uuid AND pc.context_version=(w.payload->>'context_version')::bigint
   AND pc.consumed_at IS NOT NULL AND pc.legal_options=w.payload->'legal_options'
   AND pc.options_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(pc.legal_options)
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT combat_panel_private.validate_command(w.result->'command') command) canonical
  JOIN combat_panel_private.offers offer ON offer.id=(canonical.command->>'offer_id')::uuid
   AND offer.principal_user=pc.principal_id AND offer.actor_id=pc.actor_id
   AND offer.state='consumed' AND offer.consumed_request_key=pc.request_key
  JOIN combat_panel_private.request_receipts native_receipt
   ON native_receipt.principal_user=pc.principal_id AND native_receipt.request_key=pc.request_key
   AND native_receipt.offer_id=offer.id AND native_receipt.viewer_envelope=pc.result
   AND native_receipt.event_id=(pc.result#>>'{receipt,receipt_id}')::uuid
   AND native_receipt.command_fingerprint=public.combat_v2_sha256(
    CASE WHEN offer.kind='control' AND offer.source_payload='{"adapter":"master_v2","dispatch":"master_movement_control"}'::jsonb
     THEN jsonb_set(canonical.command,'{narrative_text}',to_jsonb(''::text),false) ELSE canonical.command END)
  JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds choice_round ON choice_round.id=(w.payload->>'round_id')::uuid
   AND choice_round.session_id=w.encounter_id AND choice_round.state='narrato' AND choice_round.phase='narrato'
   AND choice_round.narrated_at IS NOT NULL
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows choice_window ON choice_window.round_id=choice_round.id
   AND choice_window.master_session_id=p_session AND choice_window.side='png'
   AND pc.actor_id=ANY(choice_window.expected_actor_ids)
  JOIN public.combat_v2_round_reports choice_report ON choice_report.round_id=choice_round.id
   AND choice_report.narration_state='pubblicata' AND choice_report.narrated_at IS NOT NULL
   AND choice_report.values_written IS FALSE
   AND choice_report.mechanics_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(choice_report.mechanics)
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_report_publications choice_publication
   ON choice_publication.round_id=choice_round.id AND choice_publication.report_id=choice_report.id
  JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches publication_batch ON publication_batch.id=choice_publication.batch_id
   AND publication_batch.master_session_id=p_session AND publication_batch.encounter_id=w.encounter_id
   AND publication_batch.state='published' AND publication_batch.published_at IS NOT NULL AND publication_batch.retired_at IS NULL
   AND publication_batch.message_id=choice_publication.message_id
   AND ((choice_publication.primary_report AND publication_batch.source_report_id=choice_report.id
      AND publication_batch.source_round_id=choice_round.id AND choice_report.message_id=publication_batch.message_id)
    OR(NOT choice_publication.primary_report AND publication_batch.secondary_report_id=choice_report.id
      AND choice_report.message_id IS NULL))
  JOIN published p ON p.writer_work_id=publication_batch.writer_work_id AND p.message_id=publication_batch.message_id
   AND choice_window.publication_id=p.message_id
  WHERE w.kind='choice'
   AND pc.command_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(canonical.command)
   AND canonical.command->>'request_key'=pc.request_key::text
   AND canonical.command->>'activity_id'=pc.encounter_id::text
   AND canonical.command->'context_version'=to_jsonb(pc.context_version)
   AND pc.result#>>'{receipt,request_key}'=pc.request_key::text
   AND pc.result#>>'{receipt,activity_id}'=pc.encounter_id::text
   AND pc.result#>>'{receipt,round_id}'=choice_round.id::text
   AND pc.result#>'{receipt,values_written}'='false'::jsonb
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit finalized
    WHERE finalized.receipt_id=w.dispatch_receipt_id AND finalized.event_code='generic_finalized'
     AND finalized.details->>'work_id'=w.id::text AND finalized.details->>'receipt_id'=w.receipt_id::text
     AND finalized.details->>'result_sha256'=w.result_sha256
     AND finalized.details->>'result_jsonb_sha256'=public.combat_v2_sha256(w.result)
     AND finalized.details->'command_receipt'=pc.result
     AND finalized.details->>'state'='completed' AND finalized.details->>'stale'='false'
     AND finalized.details->>'outcome_uncertain'='false'
     AND finalized.details->'application_error_sqlstate'='null'::jsonb)
   AND (
    -- Ordinary native declarations must occur in the exact published report.
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_declarations decl
     WHERE decl.id=(pc.result#>>'{receipt,declaration_id}')::uuid

      AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(choice_report.mechanics->'declarations') reported

    OR (
     -- Movement control has no declaration: its native immutable receipt binds
     -- request, event, actor and round, then that exact round is published above.
     offer.kind='control' AND offer.operation='control'
     AND offer.source_payload='{"adapter":"master_v2","dispatch":"master_movement_control"}'::jsonb
     AND pc.result#>>'{receipt,operation}'='control' AND pc.result#>'{receipt,declaration_id}'='null'::jsonb
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM clan_marionettisti_private.movement_receipts movement
      WHERE movement.request_key=pc.request_key AND movement.round_id=choice_round.id
       AND movement.owner_actor_id=pc.actor_id AND movement.body_actor_id=pc.actor_id
       AND movement.result->>'event_id'=native_receipt.event_id::text)

   )
  UNION ALL SELECT request,work_id,receipt_id,result_sha256,publication FROM carry_published
  UNION ALL SELECT request,work_id,receipt_id,result_sha256,publication FROM retained_published
 ), settled AS MATERIALIZED(

   FROM settled_raw check_s WHERE check_s.work_id=s.work_id AND check_s.request=s.request)
 ), combat_released AS MATERIALIZED(

 jsonb_build_object('source_work_id',w.id,'payload_sha256',w.payload_sha256,'reason','staff_combat_narration_preprovider_reissued','audit_sha256',proof.x->>'audit_sha256') release

  JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts pr
   ON pr.master_session_id=p_session AND pr.actor_user_id=t.actor_user_id

 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1 bt JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts bp ON bp.request_key=bt.request_key AND bp.master_session_id=bt.master_session_id AND bp.actor_user_id=bt.actor_user_id AND bp.result_sha256=bt.result_sha256 AND bp.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(bp.result)
 WHERE bt.master_session_id=p_session AND bt.request_key='9e48a416-9261-4399-9e4e-a82b8a3d3a48'::uuid AND bt.source_revision='24db5db8da7ede254e6d719b587c4fa04dce6b9d1c920396251adb85d0f6294c' AND bt.actor_user_id='b4952ed5-5ce0-49c0-9f2b-8fd5dcd89b4b'::uuid AND bt.staff_user_id=bt.actor_user_id AND bt.result_sha256='b27ed0db18a45d371931f015be0cd0fa060ed3f99b8d5843e8cbef45ecfbb2f8'
 AND mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(bp.result,ARRAY['schema_version','master_session_id','state','dispatch','reason_code']) AND bp.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-progress/1' AND bp.result->>'master_session_id'=p_session::text AND bp.result->>'state'='paused' AND bp.result->>'reason_code'='MGPG_C7_RUN_BUDGET_STOP' AND bp.result->'dispatch'='null'::jsonb)) AND pr.request_key=mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(t.request_key,'mission-staff-budget-only-resume/1:'||t.source_revision))

# Event48 · recupero della stessa claim e osservazione del Writer successore

## Causa dimostrata

Il terminalizer Count esistente aggiorna il vecchio Writer a failed con ricevuta/hash. Il trigger event_capture_v1, righe221–239, marca terminal l’evento che puntava a quel work. event_next46 cambiava solo work_id/canonical_request/claim_txid/backend: il dispatcher normale richiede ancora state=running e rifiutava correttamente EVENT42_SERVER_EVENT_REQUIRED. La transazione è stata integralmente annullata, senza Writer successore né nuove chiamate Count/Generation.

## Delta unico

Modificata soltanto public.mission_generic_event_next_v1. Dopo helper reissue verifica che l’evento resti esattamente quello della claim esplicita, salvo il terminale Count e updated_at: stessi claim ID, recovery nonce, root principal/receipt, source ID/hash, versione e scadenza ancora valida; stessi campi canonici precedenti. Verifica anche la lineage audit old→child già attestata. CAS sull’intero record terminale trasferisce la stessa claim al child e ripristina running. Lo stato terminale e l’eventuale settle precedente sono conservati nel claim_history con la forma esistente e in un nuovo audit append-only che collega i due request hash alla lineage.

La guardia di mission_generic_dispatch_claim_v1 non cambia: richiede ancora running, principal, lease, nonce, stessa transazione/backend e richiesta canonica. Se un campo o la scadenza cambia, il CAS fallisce e annulla atomicamente terminalizzazione tecnica, child e rebind; il vecchio Count pagato e tutti i Fati restano conservati.

## Nuovo writer_ready e chiusura

Il cambio di writer_work_id genera normalmente un secondo evento writer_ready. Il nuovo ramo, limitato al successore con lineage chiusa e source ID/hash corrispondenti, osserva quel preciso child: non seleziona un work estraneo e non chiama progress_step per creare un altro turno.

- Child già claimed/authorized/provider_started: associa work/request all’evento senza nuova lease o provider; il trigger finale chiude tutti gli eventi associati al child.
- Child già completato/fallito con ricevuta e result hash/finalize audit validi: restituisce l’osservazione terminale, senza Generation o avanzamento. event_settle conserva la propria verifica finale e le eccezioni cached-publication.
- Fonte writer_ready estranea o lineage non valida: nessun cambiamento al percorso precedente.
- Wake concorrenti dello stesso child: la prima claim normale è già nella transazione che crea il child; dopo il commit l’altro evento osserva la lease esistente, senza un secondo Count/Generation. Se la consegna si interrompe, restano i normali percorsi di recupero della medesima work.

## Consumer coperti

mission_generic_event_claim_v1 resta invariato e continua a verificare owner/recovery esplicita. dispatch_claim resta invariato. event_capture e event_settle sono stati riletti vivi in EVENT48_SETTLE_CAPTURE_ACTUAL.json e non cambiano. UI028 ed Edge114 accettano già next.state=terminal e l’unico native_claim.mode=normal usato qui.

## Confini

Source46, stage e installer precedenti non sono stati sovrascritti. Nessuna query mutante, UI, provider, nuova role, nuovo Director o modifica ai Fati. Una sola query readonly per i due consumer mancanti. Runtime e materiale restano NOT_RUN/NOT_APPLIED fino alla review indipendente e al normale tentativo Staff autorizzato.
