 st_work record;st_source record;st_dispatch jsonb;st_next_key uuid;st_original_key uuid;st_owner boolean:=false;
 st_valid boolean:=false;st_released boolean:=false;st_blocked boolean:=false;st_resume boolean:=false;
 st_ack_predecessor uuid:=NULL;st_candidate_predecessor uuid:=NULL;
 st_depth integer:=0;st_state text;st_public_state text;st_recovery uuid;st_effective_id uuid;
 st_budget_a mission_generic_owner.dispatch_admissions;st_budget_g mission_generic_owner.provider_policy;st_budget_p record;
 mb_read_recovery boolean:=false;mb_mode boolean:=false; st_spent numeric;st_http bigint;st_bound numeric;st_cap_cost numeric;st_cap_http integer;st_budget_ok boolean:=false;
 opening_resume49 jsonb:=NULL;opening_claim_resume6 jsonb:=NULL;
 journal_settlements jsonb:=NULL;
 retained_handoff jsonb:=NULL;retained_row record;
 c26_count_view jsonb:=NULL;c26_driver jsonb:=NULL;c26_proof jsonb;c26_kind text;c26_revision text;c26_phase_kind text;
  nw_original_sha text;nw_original_key uuid;nw_mode boolean:=false;
 budget1_effective numeric;budget1_policy numeric;
 role_command_capability jsonb:=NULL;role_command_enabled boolean:=false;event42_mode boolean:=false;
begin
 if uid is null then raise exception 'authentication_required' using errcode='28000';end if;
 staff:=exists(select 1 from public.profiles where id=uid and role in('admin','master'));
 select s.* into m from public.master_v2_sessions s join mission_generic_owner.run_bindings b on b.master_session_id=s.id
 where s.location_id=p_location and s.closed_at is null and s.owner_kind='ai_service'
 and (staff or exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants p join public.characters c on c.id=p.character_id and c.user_id=uid
  where p.session_id=s.id and p.user_id_snapshot=uid and p.left_at is null)) order by s.created_at desc limit 1;
 if m.id is null then return null;end if;
 perform mission_generic_owner.assert_runtime(m.id);
 select * into strict r from public.mission_run_state where master_session_id=m.id;
 select sw.step_key into private_source_step from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches pending_batch
 join mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw on sw.id=pending_batch.source_window_id
 where pending_batch.master_session_id=m.id AND pending_batch.composition_kind='entry_png'
   AND pending_batch.state IN('preparing','ready') AND pending_batch.retired_at IS NULL AND pending_batch.message_id IS NULL
   AND pending_batch.encounter_id IS NOT NULL
 order by pending_batch.created_at desc,pending_batch.id desc limit 1;
 private_pending:=private_source_step IS NOT NULL;
 participant:=exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants p join public.characters c on c.id=p.character_id and c.user_id=uid
 where p.session_id=m.id and p.user_id_snapshot=uid and p.left_at is null);
 event42_mode:=EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1 mode42 WHERE mode42.master_session_id=m.id AND mode42.event_domain='start');
 -- Quest uses its own native source (mission_id is NULL). No private context is emitted.
 academy:=mission_creation_owner.director_context(m.id,r.current_step_key) is not null
 or exists(select 1 from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources qs
   join public.mission_plan_versions pv on pv.id=qs.plan_version_id
   join public.mission_plans qp on qp.id=pv.plan_id
   join mission_generic_owner.run_bindings qb on qb.master_session_id=qs.session_id
   join mission_generic_owner.definitions qd on qd.id=qb.definition_id
   join public.locations ql on ql.id=qs.location_id
   where qs.session_id=m.id and qs.state in('prepared','opening_pending','uncertain','started')
    and m.mission_id is null and m.tipo='quest' and qs.location_id=m.location_id
    and qs.plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id and qp.source_kind='quest'
    and qp.quest_episode_id=qs.episode_id and qp.quest_source_sha256=qs.source_sha256
    and qd.id=qs.definition_id and qd.plan_version_id=qs.plan_version_id
    and qd.plan_sha256=r.plan_sha256 and qb.snapshot_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(qb.snapshot)
    and qd.definition_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(qd.definition)
    and ql.id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid and ql.is_active and ql.is_test);
 select public_objective into objective from public.mission_plan_steps where plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id
   and step_key=coalesce(private_source_step,r.current_step_key);
 if participant and not academy then vchoices:=public.mission_generic_choices_v1(m.id);
 else vchoices:=jsonb_build_object('choices','[]'::jsonb);end if;
 active:=m.stato in('preparazione','in_corso') and m.suspended_at is null and r.run_phase in('preparazione','in_corso');
 -- Public metadata only; no work payload, private intent, role or provider configuration.
 WITH room_session_source_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT room_source.id,room_source.work_id
  FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows room_source
  WHERE room_source.master_session_id=m.id
 ), room_released_sources AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT room_source_row.id,room_source_row.work_id
  FROM room_session_source_rows room_source_row
  WHERE mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(room_source_row.id)
 )
 select uf_candidate.* into uf_work from mission_generic_owner.work_items uf_candidate
where uf_candidate.master_session_id=m.id
 and not exists(
   select 1 from room_released_sources superseded_role
   left join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches superseded_batch
     on superseded_batch.source_window_id=superseded_role.id
   where (superseded_role.work_id=uf_candidate.id
       or superseded_batch.writer_work_id=uf_candidate.id))
 and not (m.id='b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
   and mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(m.id)
   and exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows superseded
     where superseded.id=uf_candidate.id and superseded.superseded_at is not null))
 and not (
  m.id='93d78313-abde-4087-9eb7-7b96bc0fa089'::uuid
  and m.location_id='6c737082-8fc7-4fd8-b246-30297a1ed1af'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.id='3076c471-37c5-438e-8f50-0a790b787e05'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.kind='choice' and uf_candidate.state='failed'
  and uf_candidate.encounter_id='deadfef6-5b16-4921-aa86-b86ffad6f2f2'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.step_key=r.current_step_key
  and uf_candidate.run_control_version=r.control_version
  and uf_candidate.payload->>'actor_id'='1f662f89-447a-4cd3-9873-a5953a0e0d91'
  and uf_candidate.payload->>'round_id'='44061137-17a3-43fa-9225-d29aaa26e58a'
  and uf_candidate.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(uf_candidate.payload)
  and uf_candidate.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(uf_candidate.result)
  and uf_candidate.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-pre-provider-failure/1'
  and uf_candidate.result->>'failure_code'='request_validation_failed'
  and uf_candidate.result->>'provider_calls'='0'
  and uf_candidate.result->>'charged_cost_usd'='0'
  and (select md5(prosrc) from pg_proc where oid='mission_generic_owner.enqueue_choice(uuid,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure)
      ='76a88f0e93752e1456c90d160a7a855d'
  and exists (
    select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
    where ub.id='fbfc8e29-8724-4241-b2fe-22dbc17eb9e7'::uuid
      and ub.master_session_id=m.id and ub.encounter_id=uf_candidate.encounter_id
      and ub.state='preparing' and ub.entry_side='png'
      and ub.next_round_id='44061137-17a3-43fa-9225-d29aaa26e58a'::uuid
  )
  and not exists (
    select 1 from mission_generic_owner.work_items rw
    where rw.master_session_id=m.id
      and rw.dedupe_key=uf_candidate.dedupe_key||':recovery:'||uf_candidate.id::text
  )
  and not exists (
    select 1 from public.combat_v2_declarations d
    where d.round_id='44061137-17a3-43fa-9225-d29aaa26e58a'::uuid
      and d.actor_id='1f662f89-447a-4cd3-9873-a5953a0e0d91'::uuid
  )
 )
 order by (uf_candidate.state not in('completed','failed')) desc,
  case when uf_candidate.state not in('completed','failed') then uf_candidate.created_at end asc,
  uf_candidate.created_at desc,uf_candidate.id limit 1;
 if uf_work.id is not null then
  uf_state:=case when uf_work.state in('claimed','authorized','provider_started')
    and uf_work.lease_expires_at<=statement_timestamp() then 'uncertain' else uf_work.state end;
  uf_processing:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-processing/1',
   'work_id',uf_work.id,'event_id',uf_work.event_id,'request_key',uf_work.request_key,
   'revision',uf_work.revision,'state',uf_state,'created_at',uf_work.created_at,
   'finalized_at',uf_work.finalized_at,'message_id',uf_work.message_id,
   'request',jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1',
    'master_session_id',m.id,'event_id',uf_work.event_id,'request_key',uf_work.request_key,
    'expected_revision',uf_work.revision));
 end if;
 -- Freeze only identities/states needed to wake progress, never the clock. Include
 -- declarations because a completed defense may advance mechanics without a run transition.
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('encounter_id',uf_enc.id,'state',uf_enc.state,
  'rounds',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('round_id',uf_r.id,'phase',uf_r.phase,
    'state',uf_r.state,'report_id',uf_r.report_id,'narrated_at',uf_r.narrated_at,
    'declarations',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(uf_d.id,uf_d.state) order by uf_d.id)
       from public.combat_v2_declarations uf_d where uf_d.round_id=uf_r.id),'[]'::jsonb)) order by uf_r.round_no)
   from (select uf_round.* from public.combat_v2_rounds uf_round where uf_round.session_id=uf_enc.id
     order by uf_round.round_no desc limit 2) uf_r),'[]'::jsonb)) order by uf_enc.id),'[]'::jsonb)
 into uf_rounds from public.combat_v2_sessions uf_enc
 where uf_enc.master_session_id=m.id and uf_enc.closed_at is null
 and not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches hidden_batch
   where hidden_batch.encounter_id=uf_enc.id and hidden_batch.source_window_id is not null
     and hidden_batch.composition_kind='entry_png' AND hidden_batch.retired_at IS NULL and hidden_batch.state in('preparing','ready')
     and hidden_batch.message_id is null);
 uf_marker:=mission_generic_owner.unified_progress_marker(m.id);
 if private_pending then uf_marker:=jsonb_set(uf_marker,'{batch}','null'::jsonb,false);end if;
 uf_review:=coalesce((uf_marker->>'review_required')::boolean,false);
 if academy and m.stato='in_corso' and r.run_phase='in_corso' then
  select rw.publication_id into flow_publication
  from mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows rw
  join public.combat_v2_rounds cr on cr.id=rw.round_id
  join public.combat_v2_sessions cs on cs.id=cr.session_id
  where rw.master_session_id=m.id and rw.publication_id is not null
   and cs.closed_at is null and cs.state='in_corso'
  order by cr.round_no desc,rw.round_id desc limit 1;
  if flow_publication is not null then flow_state:='combat_started';
  else
   select ub.message_id into flow_publication
   from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
   where ub.master_session_id=m.id and ub.step_key=r.current_step_key
    and ub.run_control_version=r.control_version and ub.state='published'
    and ub.route is not null and ub.encounter_id is null
   order by ub.published_at desc,ub.id desc limit 1;
   if uf_work.state in('claimed','authorized','provider_started')
or exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
     where ub.master_session_id=m.id AND ub.retired_at IS NULL and ub.state in('preparing','ready','needs_review')
       and not mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(ub.source_window_id))
    or exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw
     where sw.master_session_id=m.id and sw.consumed_message_id is null
      AND NOT(sw.superseded_at IS NOT NULL AND mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(sw.id))
      and (m.id<>'b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
        or not mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(m.id) or sw.superseded_at is null))
   then flow_state:='evaluating';flow_publication:=null;
   elsif flow_publication is not null and not exists(
    select 1 from public.messages role_msg
    where role_msg.location_id=m.location_id and role_msg.kind='say'
     and role_msg.recipient_user is null
     and role_msg.created_at>(select scene_msg.created_at from public.messages scene_msg where scene_msg.id=flow_publication)
     and exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants mp
      join public.characters c on c.id=mp.character_id and c.user_id=mp.user_id_snapshot
      where mp.session_id=m.id and mp.character_id=role_msg.character_id
       and mp.joined_at<=role_msg.created_at and (mp.left_at is null or mp.left_at>role_msg.created_at)))
   then flow_state:='new_scene';
   else flow_state:='waiting_roles';flow_publication:=null;end if;
  end if;
 end if;
 if private_pending then
  flow_state:='evaluating';flow_publication:=null;
  vchoices:=jsonb_build_object('choices','[]'::jsonb);
 end if;
 mb_read_recovery:=staff AND participant AND academy AND active
  AND p_location='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid AND m.id='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid
  AND m.stato='in_corso' AND r.run_phase='in_corso'
  AND mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_count_limit_v1(m.id)='none'
  AND mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(m.id)='24db5db8da7ede254e6d719b587c4fa04dce6b9d1c920396251adb85d0f6294c'
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1 pt JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts pp
   ON pp.request_key=pt.request_key AND pp.master_session_id=pt.master_session_id AND pp.actor_user_id=pt.actor_user_id AND pp.result_sha256=pt.result_sha256 AND pp.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(pp.result)
   WHERE pt.master_session_id=m.id AND pt.request_key='9e48a416-9261-4399-9e4e-a82b8a3d3a48'::uuid
    AND pt.source_revision='24db5db8da7ede254e6d719b587c4fa04dce6b9d1c920396251adb85d0f6294c'
    AND pt.actor_user_id='b4952ed5-5ce0-49c0-9f2b-8fd5dcd89b4b'::uuid AND pt.staff_user_id=pt.actor_user_id
    AND pt.result_sha256='b27ed0db18a45d371931f015be0cd0fa060ed3f99b8d5843e8cbef45ecfbb2f8'
    AND mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(pp.result,ARRAY['schema_version','master_session_id','state','dispatch','reason_code'])
    AND pp.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-progress/1' AND pp.result->>'master_session_id'=m.id::text
    AND pp.result->>'state'='paused' AND pp.result->>'reason_code'='MGPG_C7_RUN_BUDGET_STOP' AND pp.result->'dispatch'='null'::jsonb);
 IF academy AND (mission_public_owner.role_capture_scope_v1(m.id) OR mb_read_recovery)
 
THEN
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
    WHERE c.master_session_id=m.id) THEN
    role_diag:=mission_generic_owner.role_flow_status_v1(m.id,uid);
  ELSE
    role_diag:=mission_generic_owner.role_status_snapshot_v1(m.id,uid,flow_state,uf_processing,uf_review);
  END IF;
  IF m.id='b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
    AND role_diag IS NOT NULL THEN
    role_diag:=role_diag||jsonb_build_object('flow_reason','review_required',
      'next_actor','staff','flow_detail',null);
  END IF;
END IF;
  -- C1266: new finite source opt-in, proved from server start/admission, not a client state heuristic.
  IF staff AND participant AND p_location='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid THEN
   c26_proof:=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_admissions_v1 ma WHERE ma.master_session_id=m.id) THEN mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_scope_v1(m.id) ELSE mission_generic_owner.c1266_clean_staff_admission_v1(m.id,true,false) END;
  END IF;
  IF c26_proof IS NOT NULL THEN
   c26_revision:=mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(m.id);
   SELECT st.kind INTO c26_phase_kind FROM public.mission_plan_steps st
    WHERE st.plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id AND st.step_key=coalesce(private_source_step,r.current_step_key);
   c26_kind:='none';
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_admissions_v1 ma WHERE ma.master_session_id=m.id) AND role_diag IS NULL THEN c26_revision:=NULL;END IF;
   -- Native is the currently bound mechanical FSM with a published native entry/window.
   -- No work is required: this includes gathering PG declarations/defenses after a Fato.
   IF NOT private_pending AND EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.encounters ee
    JOIN public.combat_v2_sessions cs ON cs.id=ee.encounter_id AND cs.master_session_id=m.id
    JOIN public.mission_plan_steps ps ON ps.plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id AND ps.step_key=ee.step_key AND ps.kind='mechanical'
    JOIN public.combat_v2_rounds cr ON cr.session_id=cs.id
    JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_round_windows rw ON rw.round_id=cr.id AND rw.master_session_id=m.id
    JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub ON ub.id=rw.batch_id AND ub.master_session_id=m.id
    JOIN public.messages pubmsg ON pubmsg.id=rw.publication_id AND pubmsg.id=ub.message_id
     AND pubmsg.kind='fato' AND pubmsg.recipient_user IS NULL AND pubmsg.location_id=p_location
    WHERE ee.master_session_id=m.id AND ee.step_key=r.current_step_key AND ee.run_control_version=r.control_version
     AND cs.closed_at IS NULL AND cs.state NOT IN('chiuso','annullato') AND ub.state='published') THEN
    -- Native progress does not capture narrative role submissions. Reuse the canonical
    -- read-only snapshot only after this sealed scene and published mechanical FSM proof.
    IF role_diag IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_admissions_v1 ma WHERE ma.master_session_id=m.id) THEN
     role_diag:=mission_generic_owner.role_status_snapshot_v1(m.id,uid,flow_state,uf_processing,uf_review);
     IF mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(role_diag,ARRAY['flow_reason','next_actor','roles_received','roles_required','source_revision','flow_detail'])
      AND jsonb_typeof(role_diag->'flow_reason')='string' AND role_diag->>'flow_reason'='published'
      AND jsonb_typeof(role_diag->'next_actor')='string' AND role_diag->>'next_actor'='none'
      AND jsonb_typeof(role_diag->'roles_received')='number' AND role_diag->>'roles_received' ~ '^[0-4]$'
      AND jsonb_typeof(role_diag->'roles_required')='number' AND role_diag->>'roles_required' ~ '^[1-4]$'
      AND (role_diag->>'roles_received')::integer<=(role_diag->>'roles_required')::integer
      AND jsonb_typeof(role_diag->'source_revision')='string' AND role_diag->>'source_revision' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
      AND role_diag->'flow_detail'='null'::jsonb THEN
      c26_revision:=role_diag->>'source_revision';c26_kind:='native';
     ELSE
      -- No partial role/driver contract and no generic tick when the snapshot is invalid.
      role_diag:=NULL;c26_revision:=NULL;c26_kind:='none';uf_review:=true;
     END IF;
    ELSE c26_kind:='native';END IF;
   ELSIF c26_phase_kind='narrative' AND active
    AND c26_revision ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    AND role_diag->>'source_revision'=c26_revision
    AND (mission_public_owner.role_capture_scope_v1(m.id) OR mb_read_recovery) THEN
    -- Includes legitimate ready_to_evaluate with no work: kind follows the narrative FSM, not absence of a job.
    c26_kind:='tick';
   END IF;
   -- A qualified manual scene without a role cursor keeps the existing
   -- read-only fallback revision. This does not grant a tick or create a cursor.
   IF c26_kind='none' AND c26_revision IS NULL
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_admissions_v1 ma WHERE ma.master_session_id=m.id)
    AND role_diag->>'source_revision' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN
    c26_revision:=role_diag->>'source_revision';
   END IF;
  END IF;
 -- C1264 AGG2: read-only receipt summary, confined to the existing protected scene.
 IF (m.id='ce7bc0e0-c8ed-48dd-a9ec-58c02022a7b9'::uuid OR (c26_proof IS NOT NULL AND c26_kind='tick'))
  AND p_location='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid AND staff AND participant
  AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_admissions_v1 ma WHERE ma.master_session_id=m.id) OR uid IN('f0856d53-83a6-4de0-bc0c-12c87916e665'::uuid,'b4952ed5-5ce0-49c0-9f2b-8fd5dcd89b4b'::uuid))
  AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.flow_staff_sessions f WHERE f.master_session_id=m.id AND f.enabled) OR (m.id='44078c5f-7001-4129-9506-e2f34e68c8ac'::uuid AND mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_count_limit_v1(m.id)='none'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1 bt JOIN mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts bp ON bp.request_key=bt.request_key AND bp.master_session_id=bt.master_session_id AND bp.actor_user_id=bt.actor_user_id AND bp.result_sha256=bt.result_sha256 AND bp.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(bp.result)
 WHERE bt.master_session_id=m.id AND bt.request_key='9e48a416-9261-4399-9e4e-a82b8a3d3a48'::uuid AND bt.source_revision='24db5db8da7ede254e6d719b587c4fa04dce6b9d1c920396251adb85d0f6294c' AND bt.actor_user_id='b4952ed5-5ce0-49c0-9f2b-8fd5dcd89b4b'::uuid AND bt.staff_user_id=bt.actor_user_id AND bt.result_sha256='b27ed0db18a45d371931f015be0cd0fa060ed3f99b8d5843e8cbef45ecfbb2f8'
 AND mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(bp.result,ARRAY['schema_version','master_session_id','state','dispatch','reason_code']) AND bp.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-progress/1' AND bp.result->>'master_session_id'=m.id::text AND bp.result->>'state'='paused' AND bp.result->>'reason_code'='MGPG_C7_RUN_BUDGET_STOP' AND bp.result->'dispatch'='null'::jsonb)))
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.locations l WHERE l.id=p_location AND l.is_test AND l.is_active)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.director_incomplete_reissue_proof_v1(p_work uuid, p_user uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
 rdw mission_generic_owner.work_items;
 rdwc mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1;
 rdd mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts;
 rdr mission_narrative_internal.provider_outputs_v1;
 rdu mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows;
 rdb mission_generic_owner.unified_batches;
 rdc mission_generic_owner.work_items;
 rdq jsonb;rdh jsonb;rdf jsonb;rdo jsonb;rdcount_start jsonb;rdcount_success jsonb;rdp jsonb;rda jsonb;rdrequest jsonb;rdpub boolean:=false;rdn integer;cfg jsonb;aud jsonb;prep jsonb;child mission_generic_owner.work_items;cs mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows;publication jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF p_work IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO rdw FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=p_work;
 IF rdw.id IS NULL OR rdw.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'director' OR rdw.state IS DISTINCT FROM 'failed'
  OR rdw.message_id IS NOT NULL OR rdw.result->'ok' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR rdw.result->>'provider_calls' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
  OR rdw.result->'outcome_uncertain' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR NOT coalesce(rdw.result->'failure_codes'='["MISSION_PROVIDER_INCOMPLETE"]'::jsonb,false)
  OR rdw.payload->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-director-work/4'
  OR rdw.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(rdw.payload)
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 rdq:=mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_scope_v1(rdw.master_session_id);
 rdh:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(rdw.id);
 IF rdq IS NULL OR rdh IS NULL OR rdh->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'c1266-work-execution-attestation/3'
  OR rdh->>'execution_context' IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff_mission'
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO rdwc FROM mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 WHERE work_id=rdw.id;
 IF rdwc.work_id IS NULL OR rdwc.master_session_id IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.master_session_id
  OR rdwc.contract_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(rdwc.contract)
  OR rdwc.contract->>'payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.payload_sha256
  OR rdwc.contract->>'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff_mission'
  OR NOT coalesce(rdwc.contract->'features' ? 'provider_output_retention_v1',false)
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO rdd FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_receipts WHERE id=rdw.dispatch_receipt_id;
 rdrequest:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-request/1','master_session_id',rdw.master_session_id,
  'event_id',rdw.event_id,'request_key',rdw.request_key,'expected_revision',rdw.revision);
 IF rdd.id IS NULL OR rdd.master_session_id IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.master_session_id
  OR rdd.authority_receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.id OR rdd.request_key IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.request_key
  OR rdd.request_fingerprint IS DISTINCT FROM mission_internal.fingerprint(rdrequest)
  OR rdd.envelope_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(rdd.envelope)
  OR rdd.authority_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM rdd.envelope_sha256
  OR rdd.envelope->'narrative_admission' IS DISTINCT FROM rdwc.contract
  OR rdd.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'success' OR rdd.dispatch_count IS DISTINCT FROM 1
  OR rdd.finalized_at IS NULL
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_authorizations rdz
    WHERE rdz.id=rdw.authorization_id AND rdz.receipt_id=rdd.id)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM staff_ai_quota_private.calls rdcall
    WHERE rdcall.source_id=rdd.id AND rdcall.producer='mission_generic_ai'
     AND rdcall.scope_id=rdw.master_session_id AND rdcall.call_no=1 AND rdcall.state='settled'
     AND rdcall.charged_usd=rdd.charged_cost_usd)
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT count(*),jsonb_agg(rdfinal.details)->0 INTO rdn,rdf
 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit rdfinal WHERE rdfinal.receipt_id=rdd.id AND rdfinal.event_code='generic_finalized';
 IF rdn<>1 OR rdf->>'work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.id::text
  OR rdf->>'receipt_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.receipt_id::text
  OR rdf->>'result_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.result_sha256
  OR rdf->>'result_jsonb_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(rdw.result)
  OR rdf->'stale' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR rdf->'outcome_uncertain' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
  OR rdf->'command_receipt' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT count(*),jsonb_agg(rdowner.details)->0 INTO rdn,rdo
 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit rdowner WHERE rdowner.receipt_id=rdd.id AND rdowner.event_code='c1266_async_owner_v1';
 IF rdn<>1 OR NOT mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(rdo,ARRAY['schema_version','actor_user_id','work_id','request_sha256','envelope_sha256','provider_timeout_ms'])
  OR rdo->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-generic-async-owner/1'
  OR rdo->>'work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.id::text
  OR rdo->>'request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(rdrequest)
  OR rdo->>'envelope_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM rdd.envelope_sha256
  OR NOT coalesce(rdq->'actor_user_ids' ? (rdo->>'actor_user_id'),false)
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT count(*) INTO rdn FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_outputs_v1 rdout
 WHERE rdout.work_id=rdw.id AND rdout.authorization_id=rdw.authorization_id AND rdout.dispatch_id=rdw.dispatch_id;
 IF rdn<>1 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO rdr FROM mission_narrative_internal.provider_outputs_v1 rdout
 WHERE rdout.work_id=rdw.id AND rdout.authorization_id=rdw.authorization_id AND rdout.dispatch_id=rdw.dispatch_id;
 IF rdr.dispatch_receipt_id IS DISTINCT FROM rdd.id OR rdr.provider_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'incomplete'
  OR rdr.raw_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.result->>'raw_sha256'
  OR rdw.result->>'provider_status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'incomplete'
  OR rdr.raw_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(rdr.raw_output,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
  OR octet_length(rdr.raw_output) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 262144
  OR rdr.usage IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.result->'usage'
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT count(*),jsonb_agg(rdcount.details)->0 INTO rdn,rdcount_start
 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit rdcount WHERE rdcount.receipt_id=rdd.id AND rdcount.event_code='c8_count_started';
 IF rdn<>1 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT count(*),jsonb_agg(rdcount.details)->0 INTO rdn,rdcount_success
 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit rdcount WHERE rdcount.receipt_id=rdd.id AND rdcount.event_code='c8_count_success';
 IF rdn<>1 OR rdcount_start->>'work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.id::text
  OR rdcount_success->>'work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.id::text
  OR rdcount_start->>'measurement_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rdcount_success->>'measurement_id'
  OR rdcount_start->>'generation_request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.result->>'request_sha256'
  OR rdcount_start->>'generation_request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM rdcount_success->>'generation_request_sha256'
  OR rdcount_start->>'policy_snapshot_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(rdcount_start->'policy_snapshot')
  OR rdcount_success->>'policy_snapshot_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM rdcount_start->>'policy_snapshot_sha256'
  OR (rdcount_start->>'provider_input_contract_version' IN('mission-generic-provider-input/5','mission-generic-provider-input/6')) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
  OR rdcount_success->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'success' OR rdcount_success->'generation_allowed' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit rdunknown
    WHERE rdunknown.receipt_id=rdd.id AND rdunknown.event_code='c8_count_unknown')
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT * INTO rdu FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows WHERE id=rdw.authority_receipt_id AND work_id=rdw.id;
 IF rdu.id IS NULL OR rdu.master_session_id IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.master_session_id
  OR rdu.step_key IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.step_key OR rdu.run_control_version IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.run_control_version
  OR rdu.definition_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.definition_sha256 OR rdu.source_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.payload_sha256
  OR rdu.context IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.payload->'context' OR rdu.opportunities IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.payload->'opportunities'
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;

 IF rdw.result#>>'{provider_diagnostic,incomplete_reason}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'max_output_tokens'
 OR rdw.result#>'{provider_diagnostic,http_status}' IS DISTINCT FROM '200'::jsonb
 OR rdw.result#>'{usage,output_tokens}' IS DISTINCT FROM '20000'::jsonb
 OR rdw.result#>'{usage,reasoning_tokens}' IS DISTINCT FROM '11394'::jsonb
 OR rdr.raw_output::jsonb->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'incomplete'
 OR rdr.raw_output::jsonb#>>'{incomplete_details,reason}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'max_output_tokens'
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT count(*),jsonb_agg(a.details)->0 INTO rdn,prep FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a
 WHERE a.receipt_id=rdd.id AND a.event_code='staff_director_incomplete_prepared_v1';
 IF rdn>1 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF rdn=1 THEN
  IF prep->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-director-incomplete-prepared/1'
  OR prep->>'old_work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.id::text OR prep->>'old_result_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.result_sha256
  OR prep->>'old_result_jsonb_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(rdw.result)
  OR prep->>'old_payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.payload_sha256
  OR prep->>'raw_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM rdr.raw_sha256 OR prep->>'raw_output_receipt_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rdr.id::text
  OR prep->>'source_window_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rdu.id::text OR prep->>'source_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM rdu.context->>'source_revision'
  OR prep->>'role_ids_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(rdu.role_ids))
  OR prep->>'source_before_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(rdu)-'superseded_at'-'superseded_reason')
  OR rdu.superseded_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff_failed_director_incomplete_retry' OR rdu.superseded_at IS NULL OR rdu.consumed_message_id IS NOT NULL
  THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
  SELECT count(*),jsonb_agg(a.details)->0 INTO rdn,aud FROM mission_narrative_internal.dispatch_audit a
   WHERE a.receipt_id=rdd.id AND a.event_code='staff_director_incomplete_reissued_v1';
  IF rdn>1 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
  IF rdn=1 THEN
   SELECT * INTO child FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=(prep->>'successor_work_id')::uuid;
   SELECT * INTO cs FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows WHERE id=child.authority_receipt_id AND work_id=child.id;
   IF child.id IS NULL OR child.kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'director' OR child.master_session_id IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.master_session_id
   OR child.step_key IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.step_key OR child.run_control_version IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.run_control_version
   OR child.definition_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.definition_sha256 OR child.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(child.payload)
   OR cs.role_ids IS DISTINCT FROM rdu.role_ids OR cs.context->>'source_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM rdu.context->>'source_revision'
   OR cs.source_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM child.payload_sha256 OR cs.context IS DISTINCT FROM child.payload->'context'
   OR aud->>'prepared_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(prep)
   OR aud->>'successor_work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM child.id::text OR aud->>'successor_payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM child.payload_sha256
   OR aud->>'successor_source_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(to_jsonb(cs)-'consumed_message_id')
   THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
   SELECT jsonb_build_object('writer_work_id',wr.id,'message_id',wr.message_id,'receipt_id',wr.receipt_id,'result_sha256',wr.result_sha256)
    INTO publication FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b JOIN mission_generic_owner.work_items wr ON wr.id=b.writer_work_id
    JOIN public.messages msg ON msg.id=b.message_id AND msg.kind='fato' AND msg.recipient_user IS NULL AND msg.body=wr.result->>'text'
    JOIN mission_generic_owner.unified_segment_publications_v4 pub ON pub.work_id=wr.id AND pub.message_id=msg.id
    WHERE b.decision_work_id=child.id AND b.source_window_id=cs.id AND b.master_session_id=rdw.master_session_id
     AND b.state='published' AND b.published_at IS NOT NULL AND wr.state='completed' AND wr.message_id=b.message_id
     AND cs.consumed_message_id=b.message_id AND child.state='completed';
  END IF;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-director-incomplete-reissue-proof/1','old_work_id',rdw.id,
   'master_session_id',rdw.master_session_id,'owner_user_id',prep->>'owner_user_id','can_reissue',false,'source_released',true,
   'successor_work_id',prep->>'successor_work_id','issued',aud IS NOT NULL,'published',publication IS NOT NULL,'publication',publication,
   'prepared_sha256',public.combat_v2_sha256(prep),'audit_sha256',CASE WHEN aud IS NOT NULL THEN public.combat_v2_sha256(aud) ELSE NULL END);
 END IF;
 -- Current authority only participates before the single explicit reissue, never in historical lineage.
 IF p_user IS NULL OR p_user::text IS DISTINCT FROM rdo->>'actor_user_id' OR mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_template_policy_v1(rdw.master_session_id) IS NULL THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 SELECT rr.canonical_preimage::jsonb#>'{config,c1266_director_incomplete_recovery}' INTO cfg
 FROM mission_factory_owner.editor_release_readiness rr WHERE rr.singleton AND rr.scope='staff' AND rr.state='enabled'
  AND rr.revision_sha256=rr.observed_revision_sha256 AND rr.revision_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(rr.canonical_preimage,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex');
 IF cfg->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'c1266-director-incomplete-recovery/1' OR cfg->'enabled' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
 OR cfg->>'old_work_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.id::text OR cfg->>'master_session_id' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.master_session_id::text
 OR cfg->>'old_payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM rdw.payload_sha256 OR cfg->>'raw_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM rdr.raw_sha256
 OR cfg->'max_successors' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'::jsonb OR cfg->'target_output_tokens' IS DISTINCT FROM '32000'::jsonb
 OR (cfg->>'successor_work_id'~'^[a-f0-9]{8}(-[a-f0-9]{4}){3}-[a-f0-9]{12}$') IS DISTINCT FROM true
 OR rdu.superseded_at IS NOT NULL OR rdu.consumed_message_id IS NOT NULL
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.master_v2_sessions m JOIN public.locations l ON l.id=m.location_id
  JOIN public.mission_run_state r ON r.master_session_id=m.id WHERE m.id=rdw.master_session_id AND m.closed_at IS NULL AND m.suspended_at IS NULL
  AND m.owner_kind='ai_service' AND l.id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid AND l.is_test AND l.is_active
  AND r.run_phase='in_corso' AND r.current_step_key=rdw.step_key AND r.control_version=rdw.run_control_version)
 OR rdu.context->>'source_revision' IS DISTINCT FROM mission_generic_owner.role_source_revision_v1(rdw.master_session_id)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(rdu.role_ids) rid WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.role_latest_v1(rdw.master_session_id) lr WHERE lr.message_id=rid AND lr.valid))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items newer WHERE newer.master_session_id=rdw.master_session_id AND (newer.created_at>rdw.created_at OR newer.state NOT IN('completed','failed')))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_batches b WHERE b.decision_work_id=rdw.id)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.combat_v2_sessions c WHERE c.master_session_id=rdw.master_session_id AND c.closed_at IS NULL)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items collision WHERE collision.id=(cfg->>'successor_work_id')::uuid)
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-director-incomplete-reissue-proof/1','old_work_id',rdw.id,
  'master_session_id',rdw.master_session_id,'owner_user_id',p_user,'can_reissue',true,'source_released',false,
  'successor_work_id',cfg->>'successor_work_id','issued',false,'published',false,
  'raw_output_receipt_id',rdr.id,'raw_sha256',rdr.raw_sha256,'source_window_id',rdu.id,'source_revision',rdu.context->>'source_revision');
END $function$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.unified_enqueue_director(p_session uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare mr public.mission_run_state;rb mission_generic_owner.run_bindings;ctx jsonb;sc jsonb;opps jsonb:='[]';
 item jsonb;destctx jsonb;destscene jsonb;destspec jsonb;deststep text;wid uuid:=gen_random_uuid();cutoff timestamptz:=clock_timestamp();opening_at timestamptz;last_context_at timestamptz;ids uuid[];fresh_ids uuid[];sw uuid;payload jsonb;final_trigger text;last_writer mission_generic_owner.work_items;final_fato public.messages;final_route jsonb;
begin

 if not mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(p_session) then return mission_generic_owner.flow_previous_unified_enqueue_director(p_session);end if; 
perform mission_ai_board_owner.service_only();
if exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
  where c.master_session_id=p_session) then
  perform 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
    where c.master_session_id=p_session for update;
  if exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_reissues ri
    where ri.master_session_id=p_session and ri.state='armed') then
    raise exception 'MRS_V4_LEGACY_REISSUE_ACTIVE' using errcode='40001';
  end if;
end if;
perform mission_generic_owner.assert_runtime(p_session);

 perform public.master_v2_lock_scope(p_session);
 select * into strict mr from public.mission_run_state where master_session_id=p_session;
 select * into strict rb from mission_generic_owner.run_bindings where master_session_id=p_session;
 if exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows uw where uw.master_session_id=p_session and uw.consumed_message_id is null and uw.superseded_at is null)
 then return jsonb_build_object('state','window_pending');end if;
 -- Academy valuation is complete only after the Fato for the preceding transition is published.
 -- The terminal route is a server receipt, not an invented PG role or a player click.
 if mission_academy_owner.is_academy(mr.mission_id) and mr.current_step_key='valutazione' then
  if exists(select 1 from public.combat_v2_sessions cs where cs.master_session_id=p_session and
   (cs.state<>'chiuso' or cs.closed_at is null))
   or exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.work_items wi
    where wi.master_session_id=p_session and wi.state<>'completed'
      and not (exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
        where c.master_session_id=p_session)
        and wi.state='failed'
        and (wi.result->>'reason'='new_role_before_provider'
          or exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows stale_window
            left join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches stale_batch
              on stale_batch.source_window_id=stale_window.id
            where stale_window.master_session_id=p_session
              and mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(stale_window.id)
              and (stale_window.work_id=wi.id or stale_batch.writer_work_id=wi.id)))))
  then return jsonb_build_object('state','waiting_publication');end if;
  select wi.* into last_writer from mission_generic_owner.work_items wi
   join public.messages msg on msg.id=wi.message_id and msg.kind='fato' and msg.recipient_user is null
   left join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub on ub.writer_work_id=wi.id and ub.state='published'
   where wi.master_session_id=p_session and wi.kind='narration' and wi.state='completed'
    and (wi.step_key='valutazione' and wi.run_control_version=mr.control_version
     or ub.composition_kind='combat_exit' and ub.route->>'to_step_key'='valutazione')
   order by wi.finalized_at desc,wi.id desc limit 1;
  if last_writer.id is null then return jsonb_build_object('state','waiting_publication');end if;
  select * into strict final_fato from public.messages where id=last_writer.message_id and kind='fato' and recipient_user is null;
  select t.value->>'trigger_key' into strict final_trigger
   from jsonb_array_elements(mission_generic_owner.scene(p_session,'valutazione')->'triggers') as t(value)
   join public.mission_plan_transitions pt on pt.plan_version_id=mr.plan_version_id
    and pt.from_step_key='valutazione' and pt.transition_key=t.value->>'transition_key'
   where t.value->>'source_kind'='narrative_event' and pt.to_step_key='rapid_success';
  final_route:=mission_generic_owner.apply_authority(p_session,
   mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(p_session,'academy-final:'||mr.control_version),
   (select control_version from public.master_v2_sessions where id=p_session),mr.control_version,
   final_trigger,'narrative_event',last_writer.message_id,
   encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(final_fato.body,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),null);
  perform mission_generic_owner.enqueue_transition(p_session,(final_route->>'authority_receipt_id')::uuid);
  return jsonb_build_object('state','terminal_narration_ready','transition',final_route);
 end if;
 ctx:=mission_generic_owner.narrative_context(p_session,mr.current_step_key,wid,cutoff,'{}');
 if ctx->>'schema_version'<>'mission-narrative-context/2' then raise exception 'MUF_CREATION_CONTEXT_REQUIRED';end if;
 if exists(select 1 from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources where session_id=p_session) then
   select msg.created_at into strict opening_at from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources q
     join public.mission_run_messages rm on rm.publication_id=q.opening_publication_id
     join public.messages msg on msg.id=rm.message_id and msg.kind='fato' and msg.recipient_user is null
     where q.session_id=p_session and q.state='started';
 else
 select msg.created_at into strict opening_at from mission_generic_owner.board_starts bs
 join mission_generic_owner.work_items ow on ow.master_session_id=bs.master_session_id
 and ow.payload->>'opening_start_receipt_id'=bs.id::text and ow.kind='narration' and ow.state='completed'
 join public.messages msg on msg.id=ow.message_id and msg.kind='fato' and msg.recipient_user is null
 where bs.master_session_id=p_session and bs.state='published';
 end if;
 -- The opening is mandatory. Roles before its real publication cannot answer it.
 ctx:=jsonb_set(ctx,'{sources}',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(sr order by ord),'[]')
 from jsonb_array_elements(ctx->'sources') with ordinality z(sr,ord)
 where sr->>'kind'<>'role' or exists(select 1 from public.messages rm where rm.id::text=sr->>'id'
 and rm.created_at>opening_at and nullif(btrim(rm.body),'') is not null)));

 -- Solo reissue esplicito della precedente finestra Suna già pubblicata.
 -- Il contesto attuale conserva nuovo piano, Creation e autorità; si recuperano
 -- soltanto le fonti pubbliche originarie (role e Fato antecedente), non
 -- la prosa ormai superata dell'ultimo Fato.
 if not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
     where c.master_session_id=p_session)
   and p_session='b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
   and mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(p_session)
   and exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_reissues ri
     where ri.master_session_id=p_session and ri.state='armed') then
   if (select count(*) from mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_reissues ri
      join mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows old
        on old.id=ri.old_window_id and old.master_session_id=ri.master_session_id
      where ri.master_session_id=p_session and ri.state='armed'
        and old.consumed_message_id=ri.old_fato_id
        and old.superseded_at is not null
        and old.role_ids=ri.role_ids
        and jsonb_typeof(old.context->'sources')='array'
        and (select count(*) from jsonb_array_elements(old.context->'sources') src
          where src->>'kind'='role')=3
        and (select array_agg((src->>'id')::uuid order by (src->>'sequence')::bigint)
          from jsonb_array_elements(old.context->'sources') src
          where src->>'kind'='role')=ri.role_ids
        and not exists(select 1 from unnest(ri.role_ids) role(role_id)
          where not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(old.context->'sources') src
            join public.messages msg on msg.id=role.role_id
            where src->>'id'=role.role_id::text and src->>'kind'='role'
              and src->>'body'=msg.body
              and src->>'sha256'=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(msg.body,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
              and msg.kind='say' and msg.recipient_user is null)))<>1
   then raise exception 'SUNAV3_REISSUE_SOURCE_DRIFT' using errcode='40001';end if;
   ctx:=jsonb_set(ctx,'{sources}',(select old.context->'sources'
      from mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_reissues ri
      join mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows old on old.id=ri.old_window_id
      where ri.master_session_id=p_session and ri.state='armed'),true);
 end if;
 select array_agg((v->>'id')::uuid order by (v->>'sequence')::bigint) into ids from jsonb_array_elements(ctx->'sources') v where v->>'kind'='role';
 select max(fato.created_at) into last_context_at from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows uw
  join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub on ub.source_window_id=uw.id
  join public.messages fato on fato.id=ub.message_id and fato.kind='fato' and fato.recipient_user is null
  where uw.master_session_id=p_session and uw.step_key=mr.current_step_key
   and uw.run_control_version=mr.control_version and ub.composition_kind='narrative_continuation'
   and ub.state='published';
 -- Older roles remain narrative context; every participant answers the latest published Fato.
 if exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
    where c.master_session_id=p_session) then
   select array_agg(lr.message_id order by lr.submission_order) into fresh_ids
     from mission_generic_owner.role_latest_v1(p_session) lr
     where lr.valid and lr.message_id=any(ids);
  else
   select array_agg(rm.id order by rm.created_at,rm.id) into fresh_ids
     from public.messages rm where rm.id=any(ids)
       and rm.created_at>coalesce(last_context_at,opening_at);
  end if;
 -- Eccezione monouso: solo le tre role della finestra Suna Staff con reissue
 -- esplicito, gia' validate sopra e col Fato precedente marcato superato.
 if not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
     where c.master_session_id=p_session)
   and p_session='b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
   and exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_reissues ri
     join mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows old
       on old.id=ri.old_window_id and old.master_session_id=ri.master_session_id
     where ri.master_session_id=p_session and ri.state='armed'
       and ri.role_ids=ids and cardinality(ids)=3
       and old.consumed_message_id=ri.old_fato_id
       and old.superseded_at is not null)
 then fresh_ids:=ids;end if;
 if not (case when exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
    where c.master_session_id=p_session)
  then mission_generic_owner.role_window_ready_v1(p_session,fresh_ids,cutoff)
  else mission_generic_owner.unified_roles_ready(p_session,fresh_ids,cutoff) end)
 then return jsonb_build_object('state','waiting_roles');end if;
 sc:=mission_generic_owner.scene(p_session,mr.current_step_key);
 for item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'encounters') loop
  if not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.encounters ee where ee.master_session_id=p_session
    and ee.run_control_version=mr.control_version and ee.encounter_key=item->>'encounter_key')
   and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(item->'actors') encounter_actor
    where not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
      where ar.mission_id=mr.mission_id and ar.actor_key=encounter_actor->>'actor_key' and ar.active
        and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants p
          where p.session_id=p_session and p.left_at is null and p.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster)
      and not mission_generic_owner.npc_entry_actor_visible(p_session,mr.current_step_key,
        encounter_actor->>'actor_key',null)) then
   opps:=opps||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('opportunity_id',mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(wid,'encounter:'||(item->>'encounter_key')),
    'trigger_key',null,'source_kind',null,'label','Scontro possibile nella scena','action_kind','conflict','destination_context',case when exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'actors') entry_actor where entry_actor ? 'entry_policy' and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(item->'actors') encounter_actor where encounter_actor->>'actor_key'=entry_actor->>'actor_key')) then jsonb_set(ctx,'{sources}',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(source_item),'[]'::jsonb) from jsonb_array_elements(ctx->'sources') source_item where source_item->>'kind'='setting')) else null end,'encounter_key',item->>'encounter_key','allowed_entry_sides',jsonb_build_array('pg','png'),
    'destination_entry_candidates',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('actor_key',entry_actor->>'actor_key',
      'visible_on_enter',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,visible_on_enter}',
      'visibility_trigger_key',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,visibility_trigger_key}',
      'entry_capabilities',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,entry_capabilities}',
      'offense_allowed',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,offense_allowed}') order by ord),'[]'::jsonb)
     from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'actors') with ordinality current_actors(entry_actor,ord)
     where entry_actor ? 'entry_policy' and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(item->'actors') encounter_actor
       where encounter_actor->>'actor_key'=entry_actor->>'actor_key')
       and not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
       where ar.mission_id=mr.mission_id and ar.actor_key=entry_actor->>'actor_key' and ar.active
         and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants p where p.session_id=p_session and p.left_at is null and p.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster)),
    'allowed_actor_keys',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(aa->>'actor_key'),'[]') from jsonb_array_elements(item->'actors') aa
    where not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
     where ar.mission_id=mr.mission_id and ar.actor_key=aa->>'actor_key' and ar.active
      and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants p
       where p.session_id=p_session and p.left_at is null and p.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster))));
  end if;
 end loop;
 for item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'triggers') where value->>'source_kind' in('narrative_event','player_choice')
  and not (mission_academy_owner.is_academy(mr.mission_id) and value->>'fact_code' in('academy_d100_success','academy_d100_complication')) loop
  select pt.to_step_key into strict deststep from public.mission_plan_transitions pt where pt.plan_version_id=mr.plan_version_id
   and pt.from_step_key=mr.current_step_key and pt.transition_key=item->>'transition_key';
  destscene:=mission_generic_owner.scene(p_session,deststep);destspec:=null;destctx:=null;
  if EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_admissions_v1 ma WHERE ma.master_session_id=p_session) OR exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c where c.master_session_id=p_session)
    or jsonb_array_length(destscene->'encounters')=1
    or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(destscene->'actors') entry_actor where entry_actor ? 'entry_policy') then
   destspec:=case when destscene ? 'arrival_conflict'
     or mission_generic_owner.mandatory_arrival(mr.plan_version_id,destscene)
     or exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(destscene->'actors') entry_actor
       where entry_actor#>>'{entry_policy,offense_allowed}'='true' and entry_actor#>>'{entry_policy,visible_on_enter}'='true')
    then destscene->'encounters'->0 else null end;
   -- La topologia obbligatoria del piano approvato mantiene l'ingaggio; il marker ne precisa causa e lato.
   if destspec is not null and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(destspec->'actors') encounter_actor
      left join lateral (select a->'entry_policy' policy from jsonb_array_elements(destscene->'actors') a
        where a->>'actor_key'=encounter_actor->>'actor_key') actor_policy on true
      where actor_policy.policy is not null
        and not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
          where ar.mission_id=mr.mission_id and ar.actor_key=encounter_actor->>'actor_key' and ar.active
            and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants p
              where p.session_id=p_session and p.left_at is null and p.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster)
        and actor_policy.policy->>'visible_on_enter'='false'
        and actor_policy.policy->>'visibility_trigger_key' is distinct from item->>'trigger_key')
   then destspec:=null;end if;
   destctx:=mission_generic_owner.narrative_context(p_session,deststep,wid,cutoff,
     jsonb_build_object('entry_preview','private'));
   destctx:=jsonb_set(destctx,'{sources}',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(ds),'[]') from jsonb_array_elements(destctx->'sources') ds where ds->>'kind'='setting'));
  end if;
  opps:=opps||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('opportunity_id',mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(wid,'trigger:'||(item->>'trigger_key')),
   'trigger_key',item->>'trigger_key','source_kind',item->>'source_kind','label',left(item->>'label'||case when destspec is null then ''
    else ' Causa visibile: '||coalesce(destscene#>>'{arrival_conflict,public_cause}',
      nullif(btrim(destctx#>>'{director_context,entry_public}'),''),item->>'label') end,300),
   'action_kind',case when item->>'source_kind'='player_choice' then item->>'trigger_key' else coalesce(item->>'fact_code','phase_transition') end,'destination_context',destctx,'encounter_key',destspec->>'encounter_key',
   'allowed_entry_sides',case when destspec is null then '[]'::jsonb
    when destscene ? 'arrival_conflict' then jsonb_build_array(destscene#>>'{arrival_conflict,entry_side}')
    else jsonb_build_array('pg','png') end,
   'destination_entry_candidates',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('actor_key',entry_actor->>'actor_key',
     'visible_on_enter',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,visible_on_enter}',
     'visibility_trigger_key',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,visibility_trigger_key}',
     'entry_capabilities',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,entry_capabilities}',
     'offense_allowed',entry_actor#>'{entry_policy,offense_allowed}') order by ord),'[]'::jsonb)
     from jsonb_array_elements(destscene->'actors') with ordinality actors(entry_actor,ord)
     where entry_actor ? 'entry_policy' and not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
       where ar.mission_id=mr.mission_id and ar.actor_key=entry_actor->>'actor_key' and ar.active
         and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants p where p.session_id=p_session and p.left_at is null and p.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster)),
   'allowed_actor_keys',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(aa->>'actor_key'),'[]') from jsonb_array_elements(case when destctx is null then '[]'::jsonb else destscene->'actors' end) aa
    where not exists(select 1 from mission_academy_owner.roster_actor_rules ar
     where ar.mission_id=mr.mission_id and ar.actor_key=aa->>'actor_key' and ar.active
      and (select count(*) from public.master_v2_participants p
       where p.session_id=p_session and p.left_at is null and p.engagement_state='attivo')<ar.min_roster))));
 end loop;
 if exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(opps) candidate_op
   where jsonb_array_length(coalesce(candidate_op->'destination_entry_candidates','[]'::jsonb))>0) then
   select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_set(candidate_op,'{allowed_actor_keys}',
     coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(legacy_key))
       from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(candidate_op->'allowed_actor_keys','[]'::jsonb)) as legacy_keys(legacy_key)
       where not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(candidate_op->'destination_entry_candidates','[]'::jsonb)) policy_actor
         where policy_actor->>'actor_key'=legacy_key)),'[]'::jsonb)) order by ord),'[]'::jsonb)
     into opps from jsonb_array_elements(opps) with ordinality opportunities(candidate_op,ord);
   payload:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-director-work/2','source_window_id',wid,'context',ctx,'opportunities',opps);
 else
   if not exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
     where c.master_session_id=p_session) then
     select coalesce(jsonb_agg(candidate_op-'destination_entry_candidates' order by ord),'[]'::jsonb) into opps
       from jsonb_array_elements(opps) with ordinality opportunities(candidate_op,ord);
   end if;
   
payload:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version',
  case when exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.role_window_cursors c
    where c.master_session_id=p_session) then 'mission-director-work/2'
    else 'mission-director-work/1' end,
  'source_window_id',wid,'context',ctx,'opportunities',opps);

 end if;
 sw:=wid;
 if exists(select 1 from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources where session_id=p_session) then
   select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
     'opportunity_id',mission_ai_service_owner.uuid5(wid,'quest-terminal:'||(opt->>'decision_key')),
     'quest_terminal_decision_key',opt->>'decision_key','trigger_key',null,'source_kind','narrative_event',
     'label',opt->>'decision_key','action_kind','quest_terminal','destination_context',null,
     'encounter_key',null,'allowed_entry_sides','[]'::jsonb,'allowed_actor_keys','[]'::jsonb) order by opt->>'decision_key'),'[]'::jsonb)||opps
   into opps from jsonb_array_elements(sc->'terminal_options') opt
   join mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources q on q.session_id=p_session
   join mission_generic_owner.definitions df on df.id=q.definition_id
   join mission_factory_owner.quest_decision_registry reg on reg.catalog_version=df.definition->>'catalog_version'
     and reg.catalog_sha256=df.definition->>'catalog_sha256' and reg.capability_key='terminal.result'
     and reg.decision_key=opt->>'decision_key' and reg.qualified and reg.terminal_route
     and reg.step_kind='narrative' and reg.trigger_source_kind='narrative_event';
   payload:=jsonb_set(payload,'{opportunities}',opps);
   payload:=mission_factory_owner.quest_step_payload_v1(p_session,sw,payload);
 end if;
 IF mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_scope_v2(p_session,true) THEN
  ctx:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_progression_context_v2(p_session,ctx);
  payload:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_prepare_v2(p_session,sw,ctx,opps);
  ctx:=payload->'context';opps:=payload->'opportunities';
 ELSIF mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_scope_v1(p_session,true) THEN
  ctx:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_progression_context_v1(p_session,ctx);
  payload:=mission_generic_owner.c1266_role_prepare_v1(p_session,sw,ctx,opps);
  ctx:=payload->'context';opps:=payload->'opportunities';
 END IF;
 insert into mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows(id,master_session_id,step_key,run_control_version,definition_sha256,through_at,role_ids,context,opportunities,source_sha256)
 values(sw,p_session,mr.current_step_key,mr.control_version,rb.snapshot_sha256,cutoff,ids,ctx,opps,public.combat_v2_sha256(payload));
 insert into mission_generic_owner.work_items(id,master_session_id,event_id,dedupe_key,step_key,run_control_version,definition_sha256,authority_receipt_id,kind,revision,payload,payload_sha256)
 values(wid,p_session,sw,'director:'||sw,mr.current_step_key,mr.control_version,rb.snapshot_sha256,sw,'director',mr.control_version,payload,public.combat_v2_sha256(payload));
 update mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows set work_id=wid where id=sw;
 update mission_generic_owner.staff_fato_reissues
   set state='enqueued',new_window_id=sw,enqueued_at=clock_timestamp()
   where master_session_id=p_session and state='armed';
 return jsonb_build_object('work_id',wid,'state','director_ready');
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mission_generic_owner.c1266_historical_work_v1(p_work uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE w mission_generic_owner.work_items;wc mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1;
 b mission_generic_owner.board_starts;rb mission_generic_owner.run_bindings;e jsonb;q49 jsonb;s49 mission_generic_owner.simulation_sources;m49 public.master_v2_sessions;cap49 mission_ai_service_owner.capabilities;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO w FROM mission_generic_owner.work_items WHERE id=p_work;
 SELECT * INTO wc FROM mission_public_owner.work_contracts_v1 WHERE work_id=p_work;
 IF w.id IS NULL OR wc.work_id IS NULL OR wc.contract_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(wc.contract)
 OR (wc.master_session_id,wc.definition_sha256,wc.payload_sha256) IS DISTINCT FROM(w.master_session_id,w.definition_sha256,w.payload_sha256)
 OR w.payload_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(w.payload)
 OR wc.contract->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'mission-narrative-admission/3'
 OR NOT(wc.contract->'features' ? 'execution_authority_v1') THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 e:=wc.contract#>'{source_attestation,execution_authority}';
 IF e->>'schema_version'='c1266-work-execution-attestation/3' THEN
  DECLARE mq jsonb:=mission_generic_owner.manual_staff_scope_v1(w.master_session_id);ma jsonb;
  BEGIN
   ma:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','c1266-staff-admission-authority/3','kind','staff_finite','resource_scope','staff_simulation','finite_admission_sha256',public.combat_v2_sha256(mq),'admission_id',mq->>'start_receipt_id','location_id',mq->>'location_id');
   IF mq IS NULL OR NOT mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(e,ARRAY['schema_version','execution_context','admission','release_sha256','binding_sha256','financial_qualification_sha256','c7_budget_qualification_sha256','start_receipt_id','start_snapshot_sha256','source_scope','source_qualification','source_qualification_sha256'])
   OR wc.scope IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff_mission' OR e->>'execution_context' IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff_mission'
   OR e->'source_qualification' IS DISTINCT FROM mq OR e->>'source_qualification_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM public.combat_v2_sha256(mq)
   OR e->'admission' IS DISTINCT FROM ma OR e->'source_scope' IS DISTINCT FROM mq->'source_scope'
   OR e->>'release_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM wc.release_sha256 OR e->>'binding_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM w.definition_sha256
   OR e->>'binding_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM mq->>'binding_sha256'
   OR e->>'financial_qualification_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM mq->>'financial_qualification_sha256'
   OR e->>'c7_budget_qualification_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM mq->>'budget_qualification_sha256'

 IF e->>'schema_version'='c1266-work-execution-attestation/2' THEN

 IF NOT mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(e,ARRAY['schema_version','execution_context','admission','release_sha256','binding_sha256','financial_qualification_sha256','c7_budget_qualification_sha256','start_receipt_id','start_snapshot_sha256','source_scope','source_qualification','source_qualification_sha256']) (q49->>'start_receipt_id') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' AND (q49->>'binding_definition_id') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' AND q49->'actor_user_ids'='["b4952ed5-5ce0-49c0-9f2b-8fd5dcd89b4b","f0856d53-83a6-4de0-bc0c-12c87916e665"]'::jsonb AND jsonb_typeof(q49->'roster_character_ids')='array' AND q49#>>'{clean_policy_snapshot,campaign_id}'=q49->>'campaign_id' AND q49#>>'{clean_policy_snapshot,grant_id}'=q49->>'grant_id' AND q49#>>'{clean_policy_snapshot,location_id}'=q49->>'location_id' AND q49#>>'{clean_policy_snapshot,source_mission_id}'=q49#>>'{source_scope,mission_id}' AND q49#>>'{clean_policy_snapshot,source_plan_version_id}'=q49#>>'{source_scope,plan_version_id}' AND q49#>>'{clean_policy_snapshot,source_sha256}'=q49#>>'{source_scope,source_sha256}' AND q49#>'{clean_policy_snapshot,time_policy}'=q49#>'{campaign_snapshot,time_policy}' AND q49#>'{campaign_snapshot,time_policy}'='{"mode":"budget_or_explicit_stop","expires_at_role":"historical_provenance"}'::jsonb AND q49#>>'{campaign_snapshot,schema_version}'='c1266-staff-campaign/2' AND q49#>>'{campaign_snapshot,expires_at}'=q49#>>'{clean_policy_snapshot,expires_at}' AND q49#>'{clean_policy_snapshot,c7_budget_qualification}'='{"model":"gpt-6-luna","store":false,"http_limit":28,"schema_version":"c1266-clean-staff-budget-qualification/1","generation_limit":14,"reasoning_effort":"high","input_usd_million":0.1,"input_tokens_limit":24000,"output_usd_million":0.5,"output_tokens_limit":20000,"count_upper_cost_usd":"0.0124","scene_cost_budget_usd":"0.3136","generation_upper_cost_usd":"0.0124","count_qualification_sha256":"d8da6486b29f5e6b57272eb9d21660518cdcb57f12ed69209e12f32c37e2d5c0","count_reserve_contract_sha256":"13421de48d6dddbb8c6628fd6a294b90746b3d2b79e56bf617456a5d3cc8e090"}'::jsonb AND q49#>>'{clean_policy_snapshot,c7_budget_qualification_sha256}'=public.combat_v2_sha256(q49#>'{clean_policy_snapshot,c7_budget_qualification}'))) IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE

 OR e->'source_scope' IS DISTINCT FROM q49->'source_scope'
 OR q49->>'session_id' IS DISTINCT FROM w.master_session_id::text
 OR q49->>'start_receipt_id' IS DISTINCT FROM e->>'start_receipt_id'
 OR q49->>'start_snapshot_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM e->>'start_snapshot_sha256'
 OR q49->>'binding_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM e->>'binding_sha256'
 OR e->>'release_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM wc.release_sha256 OR e->>'binding_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM w.definition_sha256
 OR e->>'execution_context' IS DISTINCT FROM 'staff_mission'
 OR q49->>'location_id' IS DISTINCT FROM '0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'
 OR e#>>'{admission,campaign_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM q49->>'campaign_id'
 OR e#>>'{admission,grant_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM q49->>'grant_id'
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 ELSE
 IF NOT mission_factory_owner.keys_exact_v2(e,ARRAY['schema_version','execution_context','admission','release_sha256','binding_sha256','financial_qualification_sha256','c7_budget_qualification_sha256','start_receipt_id','start_snapshot_sha256','source_scope'])
 OR e->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'c1266-work-execution-attestation/1'
 OR e->>'release_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM wc.release_sha256
 OR e->>'binding_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM w.definition_sha256
 OR e->'source_scope' IS DISTINCT FROM '{"mission_id":"5878822d-dc03-4ac2-ad0b-1547f0ab3fc0","plan_version_id":"24b1e44a-5597-4fb0-95bd-fb13647764b2","definition_id":"ea7f54b3-d11f-463d-9a76-18c4e779f940","definition_sha256":"97fda93e9315fd3f33911146f4cb104c24df1c6108119c28a73a6dd9c54fdc48","plan_sha256":"3d75f8577ac8d173b3f3bf68f3fe7b8bdafd22bf6f2093eadd9882275aebe4d3","source_sha256":"eca0639f48346ed0c1fac786c136f557920b61310c38d85f22a5e6a7837231bd","PG_count":2,"PNG_count":2}'::jsonb
 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;

 SELECT * INTO b FROM mission_generic_owner.board_starts WHERE master_session_id=w.master_session_id;

 THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 IF q49 IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT * INTO m49 FROM public.master_v2_sessions WHERE id=w.master_session_id;
 SELECT * INTO s49 FROM mission_generic_owner.simulation_sources WHERE carrier_mission_id=m49.mission_id;
 SELECT * INTO cap49 FROM mission_ai_service_owner.capabilities WHERE id=b.capability_id;
 IF q49->>'location_id' IS DISTINCT FROM m49.location_id::text
 OR q49#>>'{source_scope,mission_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM s49.source_mission_id::text
 OR q49#>>'{source_scope,plan_version_id}' IS DISTINCT FROM s49.source_plan_version_id::text

 OR q49->>'request_key' IS DISTINCT FROM b.request_key::text OR q49->>'request_fingerprint' IS DISTINCT FROM b.request_fingerprint
 OR q49->>'activation_id' IS DISTINCT FROM b.activation_id::text OR q49->>'roster_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM b.snapshot->>'roster_sha256'
 OR q49->'roster_character_ids' IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT jsonb_agg(x.value::uuid ORDER BY x.value::uuid) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(b.snapshot->'roster') x)
 OR q49->>'capability_id' IS DISTINCT FROM cap49.id::text
 OR q49->>'capability_receipt_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM cap49.authority_receipt_sha256
 OR cap49.master_session_id IS DISTINCT FROM w.master_session_id OR cap49.start_request_key IS DISTINCT FROM b.request_key
 OR cap49.board_activation_id IS DISTINCT FROM b.activation_id
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.plan_revisions rev

 JOIN public.mission_plan_versions v ON v.id=rev.plan_version_id
 WHERE rev.mission_id::text=q49#>>'{source_scope,mission_id}' AND rev.plan_version_id::text=q49#>>'{source_scope,plan_version_id}'
 AND d.id::text=q49#>>'{source_scope,definition_id}' AND d.definition_sha256=q49#>>'{source_scope,definition_sha256}'

 AND d.plan_sha256=v.plan_sha256 AND v.plan_sha256=q49#>>'{source_scope,plan_sha256}')

 END IF;

END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mission_generic_room_state_v1(p_location uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare uid uuid:=auth.uid();m public.master_v2_sessions;r public.mission_run_state;vchoices jsonb;
 staff boolean;participant boolean;objective text;active boolean; uf_work mission_generic_owner.work_items;uf_processing jsonb;uf_rounds jsonb;uf_progress_key text;uf_state text;uf_marker jsonb;uf_review boolean;
 academy boolean;flow_state text;flow_publication uuid;role_diag jsonb;
 private_source_step text;private_pending boolean:=false;combat_recovery jsonb;
 staff_tick_view jsonb:=NULL;st_revision text;st_tick mission_generic_owner.staff_progress_ticks_v1;st_receipt mission_generic_owner.progress_receipts;
 st_work record;st_source record;st_dispatch jsonb;st_next_key uuid;st_original_key uuid;st_owner boolean:=false;
 st_valid boolean:=false;st_released boolean:=false;st_blocked boolean:=false;st_resume boolean:=false;
 st_ack_predecessor uuid:=NULL;st_candidate_predecessor uuid:=NULL;
 st_depth integer:=0;st_state text;st_public_state text;st_recovery uuid;st_effective_id uuid;
 st_budget_a mission_generic_owner.dispatch_admissions;st_budget_g mission_generic_owner.provider_policy;st_budget_p record;
 mb_read_recovery boolean:=false;mb_mode boolean:=false; st_spent numeric;st_http bigint;st_bound numeric;st_cap_cost numeric;st_cap_http integer;st_budget_ok boolean:=false;
 opening_resume49 jsonb:=NULL;opening_claim_resume6 jsonb:=NULL;
 journal_settlements jsonb:=NULL;
 retained_handoff jsonb:=NULL;retained_row record;
 c26_count_view jsonb:=NULL;c26_driver jsonb:=NULL;c26_proof jsonb;c26_kind text;c26_revision text;c26_phase_kind text;
  nw_original_sha text;nw_original_key uuid;nw_mode boolean:=false;
 budget1_effective numeric;budget1_policy numeric;
 role_command_capability jsonb:=NULL;role_command_enabled boolean:=false;event42_mode boolean:=false;
begin
 if uid is null then raise exception 'authentication_required' using errcode='28000';end if;
 staff:=exists(select 1 from public.profiles where id=uid and role in('admin','master'));
 select s.* into m from public.master_v2_sessions s join mission_generic_owner.run_bindings b on b.master_session_id=s.id
 where s.location_id=p_location and s.closed_at is null and s.owner_kind='ai_service'
 and (staff or exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants p join public.characters c on c.id=p.character_id and c.user_id=uid
  where p.session_id=s.id and p.user_id_snapshot=uid and p.left_at is null)) order by s.created_at desc limit 1;
 if m.id is null then return null;end if;
 perform mission_generic_owner.assert_runtime(m.id);
 select * into strict r from public.mission_run_state where master_session_id=m.id;
 select sw.step_key into private_source_step from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches pending_batch
 join mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows sw on sw.id=pending_batch.source_window_id
 where pending_batch.master_session_id=m.id AND pending_batch.composition_kind='entry_png'
   AND pending_batch.state IN('preparing','ready') AND pending_batch.retired_at IS NULL AND pending_batch.message_id IS NULL
   AND pending_batch.encounter_id IS NOT NULL
 order by pending_batch.created_at desc,pending_batch.id desc limit 1;
 private_pending:=private_source_step IS NOT NULL;
 participant:=exists(select 1 from public.master_v2_participants p join public.characters c on c.id=p.character_id and c.user_id=uid
 where p.session_id=m.id and p.user_id_snapshot=uid and p.left_at is null);
 event42_mode:=EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mission_generic_owner.event_outbox_v1 mode42 WHERE mode42.master_session_id=m.id AND mode42.event_domain='start');
 -- Quest uses its own native source (mission_id is NULL). No private context is emitted.
 academy:=mission_creation_owner.director_context(m.id,r.current_step_key) is not null
 or exists(select 1 from mission_factory_owner.quest_run_sources qs
   join public.mission_plan_versions pv on pv.id=qs.plan_version_id
   join public.mission_plans qp on qp.id=pv.plan_id
   join mission_generic_owner.run_bindings qb on qb.master_session_id=qs.session_id
   join mission_generic_owner.definitions qd on qd.id=qb.definition_id
   join public.locations ql on ql.id=qs.location_id
   where qs.session_id=m.id and qs.state in('prepared','opening_pending','uncertain','started')
    and m.mission_id is null and m.tipo='quest' and qs.location_id=m.location_id
    and qs.plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id and qp.source_kind='quest'
    and qp.quest_episode_id=qs.episode_id and qp.quest_source_sha256=qs.source_sha256
    and qd.id=qs.definition_id and qd.plan_version_id=qs.plan_version_id
    and qd.plan_sha256=r.plan_sha256 and qb.snapshot_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(qb.snapshot)
    and qd.definition_sha256=mission_internal.fingerprint(qd.definition)
    and ql.id='0b85f354-9cdb-47e1-baf9-3d266bb7e06b'::uuid and ql.is_active and ql.is_test);
 select public_objective into objective from public.mission_plan_steps where plan_version_id=r.plan_version_id
   and step_key=coalesce(private_source_step,r.current_step_key);
 if participant and not academy then vchoices:=public.mission_generic_choices_v1(m.id);
 else vchoices:=jsonb_build_object('choices','[]'::jsonb);end if;
 active:=m.stato in('preparazione','in_corso') and m.suspended_at is null and r.run_phase in('preparazione','in_corso');
 -- Public metadata only; no work payload, private intent, role or provider configuration.
 WITH room_session_source_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT room_source.id,room_source.work_id
  FROM mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows room_source
  WHERE room_source.master_session_id=m.id
 ), room_released_sources AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT room_source_row.id,room_source_row.work_id
  FROM room_session_source_rows room_source_row
  WHERE mission_generic_owner.role_source_released_v4(room_source_row.id)
 )
 select uf_candidate.* into uf_work from mission_generic_owner.work_items uf_candidate
where uf_candidate.master_session_id=m.id
 and not exists(
   select 1 from room_released_sources superseded_role
   left join mission_generic_owner.unified_batches superseded_batch
     on superseded_batch.source_window_id=superseded_role.id
   where (superseded_role.work_id=uf_candidate.id
       or superseded_batch.writer_work_id=uf_candidate.id))
 and not (m.id='b70b23cf-bad8-475d-a56a-d9c549e35d84'::uuid
   and mission_generic_owner.flow_scope_enabled(m.id)
   and exists(select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_source_windows superseded
     where superseded.id=uf_candidate.id and superseded.superseded_at is not null))
 and not (
  m.id='93d78313-abde-4087-9eb7-7b96bc0fa089'::uuid
  and m.location_id='6c737082-8fc7-4fd8-b246-30297a1ed1af'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.id='3076c471-37c5-438e-8f50-0a790b787e05'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.kind='choice' and uf_candidate.state='failed'
  and uf_candidate.encounter_id='deadfef6-5b16-4921-aa86-b86ffad6f2f2'::uuid
  and uf_candidate.step_key=r.current_step_key
  and uf_candidate.run_control_version=r.control_version
  and uf_candidate.payload->>'actor_id'='1f662f89-447a-4cd3-9873-a5953a0e0d91'
  and uf_candidate.payload->>'round_id'='44061137-17a3-43fa-9225-d29aaa26e58a'
  and uf_candidate.payload_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(uf_candidate.payload)
  and uf_candidate.result_sha256=public.combat_v2_sha256(uf_candidate.result)
  and uf_candidate.result->>'schema_version'='mission-generic-pre-provider-failure/1'
  and uf_candidate.result->>'failure_code'='request_validation_failed'
  and uf_candidate.result->>'provider_calls'='0'
  and uf_candidate.result->>'charged_cost_usd'='0'
  and (select md5(prosrc) from pg_proc where oid='mission_generic_owner.enqueue_choice(uuid,uuid,uuid)'::regprocedure)
      ='76a88f0e93752e1456c90d160a7a855d'
  and exists (
    select 1 from mission_generic_owner.unified_batches ub
    where ub.id='fbfc8e29-8724-4241-b2fe-22dbc17eb9e7'::uuid
      and ub.master_session_id=m.id and ub.encounter_id=uf_candidate.encounter_id
      and ub.state='preparing' and ub.entry_side='png'
      and ub.next_round_id='44061137-17a3-43fa-9225-d29aaa26e58a'::uuid
  )
  and not exists (
    select 1 from mission_generic_owner.work_items rw
    where rw.master_session_id=m.id
      and rw.dedupe_key=uf_candidate.dedupe_key||':recovery:'||uf_candidate.id::text
  )
  and not exists (
    select 1 from public.combat_v2_declarations d
    where d.round_id='44061137-17a3-43fa-9225-d29aaa26e58a'::uuid
      and d.actor_id='1f662f89-447a-4cd3-9873-a5953a0e0d91'::uuid
  )
 )
 order by (uf_candidate.state not in('completed','failed')) desc,
  case when uf_candidate.state not in('completed','failed') then uf_candidate.created_at end asc,
  uf_candidate.created_at desc,uf_candidate.id limit 1;
 if uf_work.id is not null then
  uf_state:=case when uf_work.state in('claimed','authorized','provider_started')
    and uf_work.lease_expires_at<=statement_timestamp() then 'uncertain' else uf_work.state end;
  uf_processing:=jsonb_build_object('schema_version','mission-generic-processing/1',
   'work_id',uf_work.id,'event_id',uf_work.event_id,'request_key',uf_work.request_key,
   'revision',uf_work.revision,'state',uf_state,'created_at',uf_work.created_at,
